title: Lead, Solutions Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 **Job Description**

The Lead of the Solutions Engineering (Merchant/Partner Integrations) team will establish a new and steer existing team of engineers who are responsible for the success of developers integrating with PhonePe products.

At PhonePe we consider the developer experience to be central to the overall experience of our merchants. When we do our job well, merchants are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on PhonePe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex payment systems.

PhonePe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Solutions Engineering team is the glue that supports our developers and champions developer experience as part of the overall merchant experience.

Responsibilities:

* Define and deliver a comprehensive technical experience for developers integrating PhonePe
* Develop both the long-term vision and strategy for the Solutions Engineering team and manage day-to-day operations
* Work cross-functionally across PhonePe to develop solutions to meet merchant’s requirements
* Recruit, coach, and develop user facing engineers
* Inspire, motivate and enable individual development and promote career growth of the team
* Develop relationships across the entire organization at PhonePe to influence others in aiming for the best developer experience possible
* Define, implement, and monitor key metrics that ensure the future sustainability and quality of the developer experiences
* Define, document, and implement processes for integration to ensure compliance and standardization across stakeholders
* Improve API integrations by studying current market practices
* Responsible for on-time delivery and overall quality of deliverables
* Working closely with product managers on common goals to achieve best in the class developer and merchant experience for our merchants.

 **Qualifications**

* 6+ years of Techno functional experience with cross functional collaboration with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience in leading, managing and developing user-facing engineering teams
* Background in software development in one or more programming languages, preferably PHP/Java/. Net
* Direct experience as a user-facing engineer is highly desired
* Track record in successfully delivering complex, cross functional technology solutions
* You encourage a healthy work environment that’s both supportive and challenging
* You’re excited to help engineers develop new skills and advance in their careers
* You lead by example, by setting the right context, and by helping teammates do their best work
* You know when to let a team work through problems and when to jump in to help
* You’re technical enough to ask engineers good questions about design and integration decisions
* You have Strong quantitative, analytical, and Problem Solving skills
* Experience in API driven products is a big plus.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal and listening skills
* Comfortable working in a fast paced environment

 **Additional Information**

PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)

Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please fill out this form.

description:

Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. title: PMTS - DFT Architect
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**PMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER**

**THE ROLE:**

As a member of Circuit Technologies (CT) Team, you will architect, develop, and lead the DFT Design and Integration of cutting edge DFT structures including SCAN, ATPG, MBIST, BSCAN. In this role, you will work with the lead SoC/chiplet and IP architects to define future DFx architectures and contribute to product specifications, micro-architecture specifications, performance, and power trade-offs. The role will work from early concept development through the development phases to final production.

**THE PERSON:**

In this role, you will collaborate with a network of expert architects and designers around the world where collaboration and communication skills are critical to the success of this role, and excellent organization skills are essential. You will approach sophisticated problems with a firm methodology and problem-solving technique and conduct experiments and analysis to formulate recommendations and next steps for other colleagues, and SOC/chiplet and IP design teams located in across multiple time zones and geographies. You will formally present your findings to co-workers, teams, and customer engineering teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop next-generation SoC/chiplet and IP debug and observability solutions that enable secure, scalable, and robust silicon bring-up, validation, and post-silicon debug.
* Partner with architecture and SoC/chiplet and IP design teams to define and execute a comprehensive Design-for-Excellence (DFX) strategy spanning debug, test, validation, reliability, and manufacturability.
* Collaborate with technology, silicon validation, product engineering, and manufacturing teams to establish DFX architectures that support both functional operating modes and manufacturing test requirements.
* Drive cross-functional alignment on DFX requirements, use cases, and end-to-end implementation flows across AMD engineering organizations.
* Evaluate and deploy AI-driven methodologies to streamline DFX planning, insertion, verification, coverage analysis, and implementation, improving quality, consistency, and scalability while reducing manual effort and time-to-deployment.
* Define metrics, methodologies, and automation frameworks to ensure DFX solutions meet product quality, testability, debug, and production readiness objectives across multiple programs and technology generations.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* 10+ years of experience in SoC/chiplet and IP design, DFX architecture, or related silicon development disciplines.
* Strong understanding of DFX implementation and integration within complex, large-scale SoC/chiplet architectures.
* Deep knowledge of DFT methodologies and infrastructure, including scan, ATPG, MBIST, JTAG 1149.x/boundary scan, and advanced debug and test features.
* Solid understanding of SoC clocking, reset, power management, and low-power design architectures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse engineering teams and disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to decompose complex technical problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and develop solutions from both architectural and implementation perspectives.
* Experience applying AI and data-driven techniques to improve engineering productivity, including DFX requirement analysis, insertion planning, verification, coverage assessment, validation, and design quality optimization.
* Ability to leverage modern AI-assisted engineering workflows and tools to accelerate debug, reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and enable earlier identification of design and DFX risks.

**ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

title: Renewable Energy/Solar Engineer
description:
Renewable Energy Engineer / Renewable Energy Project & Business Manager

**Location:** Kingdom of Bahrain  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Minimum Experience:** 10+ Years of Relevant Experience  
**Industry:** Renewable Energy, Solar PV, Electrical Contracting and Energy Solutions  
**Reporting To:** Management / CEO

1. Position Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically competent and commercially oriented Renewable Energy Engineer / Manager to establish, develop and manage our upcoming renewable energy business in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

The ideal candidate must possess a minimum of 10 years of solid, hands-on experience and comprehensive knowledge of the entire renewable energy business lifecycle, particularly solar photovoltaic (PV) systems, electrical installations, engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), project management, operations and maintenance (O&M), and business development.

The candidate must be capable of independently managing the complete 360° cycle of renewable energy operations, from initial business development and feasibility studies through engineering, costing, tendering, regulatory approvals, procurement, installation, commissioning, customer handover and long-term maintenance.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing the technical and operational framework, developing the customer base, building supplier and contractor relationships, coordinating the relevant licensing requirements and ensuring sustainable business growth and profitability.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Renewable Energy Business Development — End-to-End Management**

* Lead the development and establishment of the company's renewable energy and solar power business in Bahrain.
* Identify and develop opportunities in residential, commercial, industrial, institutional and other suitable market segments.
* Develop relationships with customers, consultants, contractors, developers, facility management companies and government or private-sector stakeholders.
* Conduct customer meetings, site assessments, technical presentations and solution proposals.
* Develop annual business plans, sales strategies, revenue forecasts and project pipelines.
* Support management in evaluating market potential, competitor activities, pricing strategies and business expansion opportunities.

**B. Technical Engineering and System Design**

* Conduct site surveys, energy assessments, load analysis, feasibility studies and solar resource assessments.
* Design and develop grid-connected solar PV systems and, where relevant, hybrid and battery energy storage solutions.
* Prepare preliminary and detailed engineering designs, system layouts, single-line diagrams, cable sizing, protection schemes and equipment specifications.
* Select appropriate solar modules, inverters, mounting structures, cables, switchgear, protection devices and monitoring systems.
* Perform energy-yield estimates, generation forecasts, system performance calculations and financial feasibility assessments.
* Ensure that proposed systems meet applicable technical standards, grid-connection requirements, safety requirements and project specifications.

**C. Feasibility Studies, Costing, Tendering and Commercial Management**

* Prepare detailed BOQs, material take-offs, technical specifications, cost estimates and project budgets.
* Develop competitive customer quotations, tenders, commercial proposals and technical submissions.
* Evaluate project capital expenditure, operating expenditure, payback periods, return on investment and lifecycle costs.
* Assess project profitability, margins, payment terms, contractual risks and commercial viability.
* Coordinate with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors and subcontractors to obtain competitive prices and suitable technical solutions.
* Review customer contracts, tender documents, scope of work, exclusions, warranties and contractual deliverables.

**D. Regulatory Approvals, Licensing and Compliance in Bahrain**

* Coordinate with the relevant Bahrain authorities for CR activity amendments, electrical contracting licences and renewable energy contractor registration.
* Work closely with the Electricity and Water Authority (EWA), relevant engineering consultants and other authorities on applicable approval procedures.
* Coordinate solar PV contractor qualification, required technical personnel certifications, project submissions, inspections and grid-connection approvals.
* Ensure that project designs, installations and documentation comply with applicable Bahrain regulations, electrical codes, safety requirements and approved specifications.
* Maintain records of licences, approvals, technical certificates, inspection reports and compliance documentation.

The candidate must be capable of coordinating the approval process and identifying the technical and personnel requirements. Any regulated design, certification, approval or contracting activity must be undertaken by appropriately qualified and authorized personnel.

**E. Procurement, Supply Chain and Vendor Management**

* Develop and maintain a reliable supplier and subcontractor network for solar PV equipment and related electrical materials.
* Prepare procurement schedules aligned with approved project programmes and budgets.
* Evaluate technical compliance, pricing, delivery schedules, product quality and warranty conditions.
* Negotiate supplier terms and coordinate material availability, logistics, delivery and inventory planning.
* Verify material specifications, certificates, warranties and compliance with approved technical submissions.
* Manage supplier performance, material quality issues and procurement-related risks.

**F. Project Execution, Installation and Commissioning**

* Manage the complete project lifecycle from award and mobilisation through installation, testing, commissioning and handover.
* Prepare project execution plans, work schedules, resource plans, method statements and installation programmes.
* Supervise engineers, technicians, installation teams, subcontractors and site activities.
* Coordinate civil works, mounting structures, module installation, electrical cabling, inverters, protection systems, earthing and grid-interface works.
* Monitor project progress, quality, productivity, costs and deadlines.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning, performance verification and rectification of defects.
* Ensure that projects are delivered safely, within budget, on schedule and in accordance with approved specifications.

**G. Operations, Maintenance and After-Sales Service**

* Develop preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for installed renewable energy systems.
* Establish procedures for performance monitoring, fault diagnosis, troubleshooting and breakdown response.
* Monitor energy generation, system availability, inverter performance and overall plant efficiency.
* Coordinate warranty claims, spare parts, repairs, technical support and customer complaints.
* Develop annual maintenance contracts and long-term customer service arrangements.
* Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements to system reliability and energy yield.

**H. Team Leadership and Operational Management**

* Establish the technical, operational and project management procedures required for the new business.
* Recruit, train, supervise and develop engineers, technicians, project personnel and subcontractors.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor performance and establish clear accountability.
* Implement standard operating procedures for engineering, estimation, procurement, execution, quality and maintenance.
* Coordinate with management, finance, procurement, sales and administration teams.
* Prepare periodic management reports covering sales pipeline, project status, costs, profitability, risks and operational performance.

**I. Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Compliance**

* Implement appropriate health and safety procedures for electrical and solar installation work.
* Ensure safe working practices for work at height, electrical isolation, testing, commissioning and other site activities.
* Prepare and review risk assessments, method statements, inspection plans and quality documentation.
* Monitor installation quality, workmanship, equipment compliance and corrective actions.
* Promote energy efficiency, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.

3. Essential Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering or an equivalent relevant discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of substantial, hands-on experience in renewable energy, with strong emphasis on solar PV systems and electrical contracting.
* Proven experience managing the complete 360° renewable energy lifecycle, including business development, feasibility, engineering, costing, procurement, installation, commissioning and maintenance.
* Demonstrable experience in managing solar PV projects from initial customer enquiry through final handover and after-sales support.
* Strong technical knowledge of solar modules, inverters, electrical protection, grid integration, system monitoring and energy storage where applicable.
* Extensive experience in BOQ preparation, estimation, tendering, project budgeting, supplier negotiation and commercial management.
* Proven ability to manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, customer relationships, budgets and project schedules.
* Strong knowledge of electrical safety, quality assurance, technical documentation and project risk management.
* Proficiency in relevant engineering and project management software, such as AutoCAD, PVsyst, PV\*SOL, Microsoft Excel and project scheduling tools, as applicable.

4. Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* Previous experience in the GCC, particularly Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Oman or Kuwait.
* Familiarity with EWA requirements and Bahrain's solar PV approval and grid-connection procedures.
* Experience working with solar EPC contractors, electrical contractors, renewable energy developers or energy service companies.
* Experience in commercial and industrial rooftop installations and larger ground-mounted solar projects.
* Exposure to battery energy storage systems, hybrid systems, energy audits, energy efficiency and power quality.
* Relevant professional registrations, technical certifications or renewable energy training.
* Experience developing new business units, establishing operational procedures and achieving commercial targets.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed against measurable objectives, including:

* Successful establishment of the renewable energy business and completion of applicable licensing and approval requirements.
* Development of a qualified sales pipeline and achievement of agreed sales and revenue targets.
* Conversion rate of enquiries, tenders and quotations into profitable projects.
* Accuracy of project estimates and adherence to approved gross margins and budgets.
* On-time project delivery and compliance with approved technical specifications.
* Quality of installation, commissioning, documentation and customer handover.
* Customer satisfaction, repeat business and after-sales service performance.
* Development of reliable suppliers, subcontractors and technical resources.
* Effectiveness of operations and maintenance services and response to technical issues.
* Compliance with safety, quality, regulatory and reporting requirements.

Specific targets will be agreed with management based on the approved business plan, project pipeline and available resources.

6. Personal Competencies

The candidate must demonstrate:

* Strong technical judgement and practical problem-solving ability.
* Commercial awareness and a clear understanding of project profitability.
* Leadership, accountability and independent decision-making.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and customer management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* A proactive approach to business development and market expansion.
* Strong organisational, analytical and reporting skills.
* Willingness to relocate to Bahrain and build a renewable energy business from its establishment stage.

7. Expected Outcome

The successful candidate will be expected to establish a technically sound, commercially viable and operationally efficient renewable energy business, capable of delivering solar PV and related energy solutions from initial customer engagement through engineering, procurement, installation, commissioning and long-term maintenance.

The candidate must function as both a senior technical professional and an operational business leader, taking ownership of project delivery, customer satisfaction, regulatory coordination, team performance and sustainable business growth.

8. Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* An updated CV detailing at least 10 years of relevant experience.
* Educational qualifications and relevant professional certifications.
* A list of major renewable energy projects handled, including capacity, scope, role and responsibilities.
* Details of experience in solar EPC, electrical contracting, tendering, project costing and commissioning.
* Details of GCC experience and familiarity with Bahrain or EWA requirements, where applicable.
* Current location, current compensation, expected monthly salary, notice period and availability to relocate to Bahrain.

**Candidates with proven end-to-end renewable energy project and business management experience will be prioritised.**

Pay: ₹150,000.00 - ₹250,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Service Desk Engineer

Experience supporting multinational organizations

title: Sr. Network Engineer
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

**SUMMARY** Q2 is seeking a Sr. Network Engineer who is able to independently design, implement, and troubleshoot complex network solutions. This role supports enterprise environments and contributes to planning, performance optimization, and secure configuration of systems while mentoring junior team members and contributing to strategic initiatives.

**RESPONSIBILITIES** • Design and implement network solutions within a complex infrastructure • Administer network services and ensure optimal performance • Analyze, debug, and resolve network traffic and connectivity issues • Evaluate and integrate new technologies into the environment • Document technical processes and infrastructure changes • Provide support during network-related incidents and upgrades • Ensure security compliance and maintain documentation standards • Participate in 24x7 on-call rotation **EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE** • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field and a minimum of 5 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with 3+ years of experience; or equivalent related work experience • Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, and VPN technologies • Experience with Cisco ASA Firewalls, load balancers (F5, A10), and cloud networks • Expert understanding of core networking technologies including: BGP, EIGRP, Cisco routing and switching infrastructure (IOS/ IOSXE / NXOS / ACI) • Strong diagnostic and log analysis skills • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a high-pressure environment • Effective communicator with cross-functional teams • Documentation and procedural development experience • Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent highly preferred

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

**Health & Wellness**

* Hybrid Work Opportunities
* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
* Community Volunteering & Company Philanthropy Programs
* Employee Peer Recognition Programs – “You Earned it”

Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer.

**Our Culture & Commitment:**

We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or veteran status.

title: Software Development Engineer II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to the team:**
-----------------------------

  

We’re the Insurance team at Expedia Group. We build services and customer experiences that help travelers find and manage trip-protection options across brands such as Expedia , Vrbo, and Hotels.com .

Our systems connect insurance suppliers and their products to multiple points in the travel journey, including checkout, post-purchase, and trip management. We focus on making these experiences reliable, clear, and easy to use.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality software that delivers reliable, accessible, and intuitive customer experiences.
* Translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions using modern software development technologies and sound engineering practices.
* Contribute to low-level system design, API design, and data modeling to support maintainable, resilient, and secure applications.
* Own features or components through design, implementation, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Collaborate across engineering, product, design, and other technical teams to deliver outcomes across multiple problem spaces.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve product and engineering outcomes, applying foundational AI/ML concepts to real-world products and workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 2+ years of relevant professional experience in software development.
* Experience owning features or components within a service or application from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and support.
* Proficiency in software development, API integration, data modeling, version control, automated testing, debugging, and production support.
Familiarity with low-level system design and developing maintainable, reliable, secure, and operationally resilient software solutions, as well as AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience delivering software products at scale with a focus on performance, accessibility, usability, security, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and production insights to make technical decisions, diagnose complex issues, and improve the reliability and maintainability of production applications.
* Experience contributing to architecture and design decisions across multiple services or technical domains while collaborating effectively with partner teams.
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools or applying AI/ML concepts to improve product capabilities, engineering workflows, or customer outcomes.
Experience safely integrating, monitoring, and operating AI/ML-enabled features within software applications, with attention to reliability, governance, and measurable impact.  

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: API Infrastructure Engineer - BA4
description:
Date live: 10/16/2026

Business Area: Customer Digital and Data

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000136179

  

**API : Infrastructure Engineer - BA4**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for an experienced infrastructure Engineer who can build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

You will provide L2/L3 support for infrastructure and application stack while driving automation, reliability (SRE), and release excellence across environments.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build and deliver high-quality infrastructure solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Deep experience in infrastructure engineering activities, including IAC, automation, design governance and troubleshooting.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* To perform assigned activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in Skillset like Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, python, API, docker, containers, ECR, EKS and GitLab.
* Build modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security controls and release automation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owner, Solution Architect, Security, Platform and QA teams to deliver integrated digital solutions.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, risk, governance and regulatory requirements.
* Support cross-platform initiatives through working knowledge of iOS development principles and mobile ecosystem standards.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

* Support recruitment, onboarding, and team growth initiatives.

* Strong advocate of clean, testable, and maintainable code.

**Key Technical Skills and Experience**
---------------------------------------

* Programming language python or Java
* Core Technical Skills: Apigee Edge (Google Cloud), Business works, TIBCO EMS and MQ.
* Technical Skills Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Shell script, Datadog, docker, containers, GitLab, Snyk, Qualys, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Maven, Gradle, and NPM
* Good to Have: JavaScript, Java, Cucumber, JUnit
* AWS cloud computing EC2, ECR, EKS, S3, Cloud Formation, networks
* Database design and SQL
* Operating System knowledge – Windows, Linux and awareness on AIX
* System design and architecture.
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, token exchange, policy systems, delegated administration, or identity data modelling
* Ability to use AI engineering tools to accelerate research, code understanding, prototyping, implementation, and documentation while applying sound engineering judgment
* Experience building production services, distributed systems, or shared platform capabilities
* Experience designing and implementing APIs, RESTful services, integration contracts, and data or domain models
* Experience turning requirements and ambiguous problems into designs, prototypes, and production-ready solutions
* Experience with authentication, authorization, and identity management
* Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, collaborate across teams and time zones, and support other engineers through feedback and knowledge sharing
* Familiarity with MCP, agent skills, and other agent integration concepts
* Experience contributing to technical designs and proof of concept work
* Manage incidents, problems, and changes using ITIL-aligned processes and SLAs (e.g., ServiceNow/Jira).
* Plan and execute OS patching cycles; maintain compliance with security and audit requirements.
* Maintain comprehensive runbooks, knowledge base articles, and support documentation.
* Very good understanding and solid hands-on on cloud computing system preferably AWS.
* Strong understanding on containers and hands-on experience in EKS/Docker also ability to write and deploy Helm chart.
* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Nexus) to improve release velocity and quality.
* Hands-on experience in Blue-Green deployments and good understanding of various other deployment strategy.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Lead - Technical Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 **Job Description**

The Lead Technical Account Managers will play a key role by Building/Leading the team of dedicated Technical account managers and act as a subject matter expert for all technical and product related discussions. title: Identity Engineer, Identity Management
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**  
  
As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
* Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
* Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
* Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
* Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
* Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
* Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
* Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

8 to 12+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments and certificate lifecycle management solutions.  

Strong practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate templates, certificate enrollment, and certificate lifecycle processes.  
Demonstrated hands-on expertise in:  
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) design and administration.  

  Certificate Authorities, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and certificate trust chains.  
  Cryptographic concepts including public/private keys, digital signatures, encryption, hashing algorithms, and key management.  
  Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Azure Key Vault, and cryptographic key protection mechanisms.  
  Certificate-based authentication, TLS/SSL, mutual TLS (mTLS), code signing, and secure communications.
Experience implementing certificate lifecycle management solutions and certificate automation across enterprise environments.  
Experience supporting cloud and hybrid PKI environments integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure services, and enterprise security platforms.  
Strong knowledge of certificate governance, compliance requirements, cryptographic standards, and security best practices.  
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for PKI administration, certificate management, and reporting.  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills within complex enterprise environments.  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, capable of working with technical and non-technical stakeholders .
  

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with DigiCert, Keyfactor, AppViewX, Venafi, Microsoft Cloud PKI, or similar certificate lifecycle management platforms.  

Experience with Microsoft Intune certificate deployment (SCEP/PKCS), Azure Key Vault, HSM technologies, cryptographic key management, and enterprise PKI governance.  
Experience implementing certificate automation, non-human identity (NHI) management, machine identity security, and PKI modernization initiatives.  
Knowledge of Zero Trust, modern identity security, certificate-based authentication, quantum-safe cryptography trends, and cloud security architectures.  
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, AZ-500, AZ-104, or relevant PKI/security certifications; healthcare or other regulated industry experience is a plus.
  

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: Senior Staff ATE Test Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and Power products, plus winning combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.  
  
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Job Description**

Position Summary

As a **Senior Staff Test Engineer,** you will be responsible to apply a broad level of expertise and knowledge in test discipline, leading and contributing to the development of the company objectives and principles to achieve goals in creative and effective ways.

This position will work on significant and unique issues, where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles. You will be required to apply conceptual thinking to understand advanced issues and their implications. It will be necessary to exercise independent judgement in methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results, for which you will be held responsible and may impact the larger business.

In the more senior role in this range, you will be expected to create formal networks involving coordination among groups, focusing on providing thought leadership while working on projects that affect the broader organization, and will require an understanding of the larger business.

This role will require conveying advanced information and persuading a diverse set of stakeholders as needed. In this role you will be expected and acknowledged as a subject matter expert and may direct the activities of others as a technical lead. You will be fully accountable for the results of yourself and your team members. In the more junior role, you will work as a part of the technical team executing the objectives understood to expected milestones, with accountability on results.

In both cases, you will work with your team/leadership to set schedules and to meet commitments. You will endeavor to identify enablement or readiness gaps and close them. Senior people will provide technical support as needed to their peers, and more junior members will request support as required to stay on track. When conflict in priorities occur, you will work resolve them and/or set updated expectations.

Renesas Electronics, a leading global semiconductor company, is rapidly scaling investing in power delivery business. Products include Point of loads (POL), Hotswap/Efuse, drivers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop best of class test programs to support key NPI, quality & capability initiatives
* Support qualification, characterization, and correlation of developed products
* Train and guide more junior team members, building their skill sets and capabilities for independent success
* Work with leadership to implement processes, procedures, guidelines and specifications that define and drive execution and quality for the test group
* Implement and develop baseline software and hardware solutions for scaling the broader team or organization
* Determine and report ROI inputs for planning and test flow with revenue, COGS and capacity mindfully in focus
* Complete quality planning, hardware and software reviews for the test group
* Coordinate with product engineering and operations to enable seamless production ramp and release
* Support production yield and customer return activities for quality
* Act as a test platform expert on the ATE equipment in use for the test group
* Serve as a mentor for younger and less experienced engineers
* Support the tech/lab team in dealing with equipment calibration and maintenance issues and planning as required
* Manage 3rd party relationships and building success with external technical teams

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or Computer Science
* 10 to 12+ years of experience working with Automated Test Systems (ATE).
* 10 to 12+ years of hands-on experience in ATE test development for analog, digital and mixed signal, with a strong focus on analog power product testing and high current testing. Experience on ATE platforms like DMDX, STS8300 is a plus.
* Experience in programming such as C++, basic, Perl, python, etc.
* Experience in testing and collecting data on IC chips or circuits using standard tools such as Oscilloscopes, Multimeters, Spectrum Analyzers, etc.
* Proficient with ATE analog digital instruments, PCB layout parasitic reduction, and strong debug/troubleshooting experience
* Hands-on experience in debugging analog products with serial bus interfaces
* Experience with test hardware and test program development

 **Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: NBIOT L2 Engineer
description:
Mavenir is building the future of networks and pioneering advanced technology, focusing on the vision of a single, software-based automated network that runs on any cloud. As the industry's only end-to-end, cloud-native network software provider, Mavenir is transforming the way the world connects, accelerating software network transformation for 250+ Communications Service Providers in over 120 countries, which serve more than 50% of the world’s subscribers.

**Role Summary**

Plans, designs, develops and tests software systems or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools.  
May use common development methodologies such as Waterfall and Agile.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and debug Layer 2/3 control and data path features
* Maintain MAC scheduler behavior for UL/DL grant decisions and resource allocation
* Work on RLC and PDCP flows for segmentation, retransmission, reordering, and bearer management
* Implement and validate UE/CELL state transitions driven by RRC and S1AP/X2AP messages
* Troubleshoot protocol interoperability and real-world failure scenarios
* Optimize scheduler and bearer behavior for NB-IoT constraints such as coverage, latency, and power efficiency

**Job Requirements**

### **Must-have skills**

* Strong understanding of 3GPP LTE/NB-IoT Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols:MAC scheduling, HARQ, RACH, paging, logical channels, and UE state handlingRLC modes and retransmission behaviorPDCP sequence numbering, security, ROHC, and bearer managementRRC setup/reconfiguration/release and UE control proceduresS1AP/X2AP signaling and UE/cell context management
* Hands-on experience in C/C++ development for telecom or embedded networking stacks
* Familiarity with low-latency, real-time scheduling and event-driven protocol processing
* Experience with:Linux/Unix environmentsmultithreading and shared-memory designtimers, state machines, and protocol packet processingdebugging packet traces and protocol logs
* Understanding of LTE/NB-IoT bearer concepts:SRB/DRBlogical channels and transport channelsUE context, cell context, and RB reconfigurationconnection establishment, mobility, and release procedures

### **Preferred experience**

* Experience with NB-IoT or LTE eNodeB stack development
* Knowledge of 3GPP specs: MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC, S1AP, X2AP
* Familiarity with ASN.1 / protocol encoders/decoders
* Experience with security/encryption functions used in PDCP
* Exposure to scheduler optimization, throughput/latency tuning, and interference handling
* Ability to work with vendor stacks and trace tools such as Wireshark, logs, and internal UE/eNB diagnostics

**Accessibility**

Mavenir is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you require any assistance, please state in your application or contact your recruiter.

Mavenir is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes qualified applicants from around the world, regardless of their ethnicity, gender, religion, nationality, age, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Full-Stack AI Engineer** with hands-on experience in Python-based application development, modern frontend frameworks, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing end-to-end AI-powered applications, building scalable backend services and intuitive user interfaces, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), and implementing AI-driven workflows. The candidate should have a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications using Python backend frameworks and modern frontend technologies.
* Build RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Design and integrate Machine Learning and Deep Learning models into real-world applications.
* Develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Integrate AI models and services through APIs, including cloud-based AI platforms.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, data processing pipelines, and external service integrations.
* Develop efficient, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform debugging, testing, performance optimization, and deployment of applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **1. Full-Stack Development**

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Hands-on experience with at least one Python backend framework: FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience building REST APIs, integrating third-party services, and implementing backend business logic.
* Working knowledge of React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, or an equivalent modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration, authentication, application architecture, and state management.

### **2. Machine Learning and Deep Learning**

* Understanding of core Machine Learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts and neural network architectures.
* Hands-on experience with libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.

### **3. Generative AI and LLM Applications**

* Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or other equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and context management.
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document processing.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and response quality optimization.

### **4. Agentic AI and AI Workflows**

* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and state management.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, planning, task decomposition, and tool integration.
* Ability to build AI workflows that interact with APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Understanding of agent evaluation, error handling, observability, and reliable execution.

### **5. Databases, Cloud, and Deployment**

* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and vector databases.
* Understanding of Git, version control, debugging, and testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Exposure to cloud platform (Microsoft Azure).
* Understanding of application security, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of relevant software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, learn new technologies quickly, and collaborate effectively with a team.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

  

**DISCLAIMER AND NOTIFICATION**

description:
Meet the Team
  
Our Routing SD-WAN Group is at the forefront of innovation, delivering intelligent, secure, and scalable WAN edge solutions that empower enterprises to connect and protect their networks from the edge to the cloud. Within this group, the Routing Platform Software team builds industry-leading headend SD-WAN and edge routing platforms. We are a high-energy group working on next-generation routing and services at a global scale, connecting thousands of devices and millions of users.
  
  
Your Impact
  
We are looking for a software engineer to develop and evolve the forwarding and platform software that powers SD-WAN and edge routing. In this role, you will collaborate with ASIC, hardware, and cross-functional engineering teams to define new architectures, implement high-performance packet forwarding, and deliver robust, production-ready features. You will leverage modern AI tools to enhance software development practices, helping to drive greater efficiency, quality, and innovation across the team.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Hardware-Software Integration: Collaborate closely with hardware engineering teams to bring up new platforms, develop low-level drivers, and integrate Network Interface Modules (NIMs).
* Firmware Development: Design, implement, and maintain ROMMON and bootloader software to ensure secure and reliable system initialization.
* Forwarding Plane Optimization: Develop and tune high-performance forwarding plane software to meet the rigorous demands of modern secure routing environments.
* Performance Debugging: Perform deep-dive analysis into performance bottlenecks at the kernel and hardware-abstraction layers, including the control plane.
* Modern Development Practices: Utilize modern development workflows, including AI-assisted coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or Codex) and integrated development environments like VSCode, to accelerate the development lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 4-8 years of industry experience with end-to-end software development in networking, including platforms, system software, kernel/user-space drivers, bootloaders, and BIOS.
* Strong proficiency in C/C++ with a focus on systems programming and Linux environments.
* Proven experience in developing device drivers and working with RTOS/Linux kernels.
* Solid understanding of routing architectures and Layer 2/Layer 3 networking protocols (e.g., Ethernet, VLANs, STP).
* Experience with bootloaders (ROMMON), hardware bring-up, and board support packages (BSP).

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Knowledge of high-speed interfaces (PHY, MAC, MACSEC) and DPDK.
* Debugging experience with hardware interfaces (i2c, PCIe) and hardware/software debuggers (e.g., GDB, Arium, BDI).
* Knowledge of x86 or ARM assembly code, instruction sets, and ABIs.
* Experience with AI/ML techniques and tools for development (e.g., code assistants, static analysis tools, test automation platforms).
* Strong collaborative skills and the ability to debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, and software layers.
