title: Principal Engineer – Design Engineering
description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the *Aggregate System* and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

**Job Description:**

Microchip’s Communications Business Unit (CBU) develops high-performance networking, connectivity, and edge compute semiconductor solutions that power communications infrastructure, data centers, automotive systems, aerospace and defense platforms, and industrial applications. Our global team works across the full product lifecycle to deliver innovative products that enable the world’s most demanding connected systems.

The CBU Product Development team is engaged through the full device R&D cycle from concept, design and implementation stages. Once a prototype is available, we support embedded software development and system validation lab testing through to mass-market production release. We are an experienced chip team working with the latest semiconductor development tools and methodologies in advanced process technologies to develop state-of-the-art network devices.

We are seeking a Principal Engineer in the CBU Product Development team who will be responsible for the design and implementation of digital integrated circuits at the block or top level of a device, solve challenging engineering problems with innovative solutions. You will collaborate with chip architects, subsystem leads and verification team members to deliver increasingly complex designs in a friendly and professional environment.

Responsibilities may include:

* Contribute to the microarchitecture of communication semiconductor devices in partnership with team leads, mentors and device architects
* Design digital circuits based on leading-edge industry standards and market requirements
* Implement designs in System Verilog RTL code utilizing low-power design principles
* Synthesize designs into logic gates taking advantage of industry-leading tools and flows
* Provide floor-planning guidance and support to physical design/layout teams
* Integrate digital and analog circuits with Design-for-Test (DFT) techniques
* Verify physical timing specifications through Static Timing Analysis (STA)
* Support of products from Specification through to Production in collaboration with Engineers in Physical Design, Validation, Applications, Software/Firmware, Product Marketing and Production Engineering
* Develop areas of technical expertise to contribute to the wider team beyond individual deliverables or responsibilities

**Requirements/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
* 8+ years related experience
* Excellent analytical and debugging skills and the ability to proactively solve issues
* Proven ability to thrive on, learn and adapt to new methodologies and technologies
* Coding expertise in one or more of SystemVerilog/Verilog or VHDL.
* Experience using one or more of Tcl/Perl/Python, C/C++, XML
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Experience with Lint, CDC, formal verification, logic synthesis, and static timing analysis.
* Understanding of physical design interactions, including timing, power, and congestion considerations.
* Knowledge of DFT, including scan, testability considerations, and DFT sign-off interactions.
* Proficiency in scripting languages such as Tcl, Perl, and/or Awk.
* Experience with Synopsys or Cadence tool flows for synthesis, verification or STA (an asset)
* Experience with 28nm and smaller silicon process technologies (an asset)

**Travel Time:**

0% - 25%

**To all recruitment agencies**: *Microchip Technology Inc.* ***does not*** *accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Infrastructure Software
description:
**Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.

**Role Summary**

The Infra-Dev team builds the software that runs Netradyne's cloud infrastructure. We write the internal platforms, automation and AI agents that DevOps, Database and engineering teams use every day: cloud cost analytics and anomaly detection, self-service service provisioning on AWS, an internal developer platform on Kubernetes, database access and upgrade automation, S3 data lifecycle and retention, and agentic tooling for infrastructure operations and on-call.

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to provide technical leadership for Infra-Dev. You will own the team's technical goals and major platforms, decide how new initiatives are approached, and stay hands-on in design and code. You bring wide-ranging experience across cloud infrastructure, software engineering, databases and cost management, and you understand how these disciplines affect one another.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Act as technical owner and architect for Infra-Dev's major platforms: the cloud operations and cost platform, the service provisioning tooling, the internal developer platform and infrastructure AI agents.

* Lead the design and delivery of multi-quarter initiatives such as containerising services onto Kubernetes (EKS), GitOps-based internal developer platforms, an infrastructure registry of service and resource dependencies, and infrastructure-as-code standardisation.

* Decide the methods, tools and standards for new assignments, including build-vs-buy evaluations, technology selection and migration plans.

* Lead cloud cost management (FinOps) engineering: cost allocation and unit economics (for example, cost per device or per feature), forecasting, anomaly detection, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance coverage, and COGS/OpEx reporting for engineering and finance leadership.

* Act as a technical point of contact for Finance and cloud vendors (AWS account and TAM teams, tooling vendors) on cost analysis, forecasts, commitments and renewals.

* Own the architecture of data lifecycle and storage-cost programs for petabyte-scale S3 data: retention policies, storage-class transitions, data retirement and safe deletion with customer-specific exceptions.

* Run the team's recurring cost and operations reviews, turning findings into prioritised engineering work and measurable savings.

* Define the architecture for agentic infrastructure operations: triage and on-call agents, MCP gateways and human-in-the-loop approvals, with clear security guardrails.

* Set standards for database and access automation across PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, OpenSearch, ClickHouse and DynamoDB, working closely with the Database team.

* Provide architecture guidance on shared infrastructure that DevOps and Database teams depend on, including logging pipelines, internal PKI and certificates, Kubernetes secrets management and device-to-cloud ingestion (IoT, Kinesis Video Streams).

* Drive security and compliance-by-default in infrastructure tooling: least-privilege IAM, credential lifecycle, secrets management, tagging and audit reporting.

* Lead architecture and design reviews, RFCs and technical decisions for Infra-Dev, and review designs from DevOps and Database teams where they intersect.

* Identify and address scalability, reliability, cost and security risks across the infrastructure stack before they become incidents.

* Lead investigation of complex production issues that cross application, database, network and cloud layers, and drive lasting fixes.

* Plan sprints and roadmaps with engineering leadership: break down work, manage dependencies, track delivery and report progress with team metrics.

* Make sure critical knowledge is written down: design documents, runbooks and ownership maps for every system the team runs.

* Mentor and grow engineers through design guidance, code reviews and career coaching.

* Take part in hiring, interviews and onboarding for the Infra teams.

**Essential Skills**

* 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including significant experience building infrastructure, platform, DevOps or SRE software at scale.

* Expert programming skills in Python and/or Go, with a strong record of production-quality code and code review.

* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, networking, IAM, storage, databases, messaging and billing, including multi-account and multi-cluster environments.

* Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and the cloud-native ecosystem: Helm, Argo CD, Crossplane, service networking and autoscaling.

* Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Terragrunt or equivalent) and designing reusable modules and golden paths.

* Strong experience designing CI/CD pipelines and safe deployment strategies across multiple environments.

* Strong understanding of distributed systems: reliability, fault tolerance, idempotency, retries and capacity planning.

* Strong understanding of database operations and internals for relational and NoSQL data stores.

* Experience with cloud cost management, including cost data pipelines, cost allocation and commitment-based discounts.

* Proven ability to determine methods and approaches on new, loosely defined assignments and to evaluate trade-offs across many variables.

* Proven technical leadership: driving multi-person initiatives and mentoring engineers while staying hands-on.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, risks and cost impact to engineering and business leaders.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience building LLM agents and AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Strands or LangGraph, MCP, vector databases, agent observability).

* Experience building internal developer platforms or platform-engineering products used by many teams.

* Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry or the ELK stack.

* Experience with Snowflake, data warehouses and forecasting or anomaly detection techniques (e.g., Prophet, regression models).

* Experience with IoT or device platforms and large-scale data ingestion.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.

**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Act as the senior technical leader and approver for Infra-Dev, and own team goals for its tactical business targets.

* Support the decisions and goals of the wider Infrastructure function (DevOps, Database and Infra-Dev); your work is reviewed on completion.

* Understand how infrastructure, application engineering, security and finance depend on one another, and design solutions that work across them.

* Direct how existing engineering principles are applied in Infra-Dev, and guide the development of new infrastructure policies and standards.

* Build a culture of engineering quality, ownership, automation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Typically requires 8+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, or a PhD with 3+ years of experience.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

  

As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
Who We Are
  
**The name ThousandEyes was born from two big ideas:** the power to see things not ordinarily possible and the ability to collect insights from a multitude of vantage points. As the world continues its digital transformation and relies more on cloud services and the Internet, the"network" which is now both public and private, has become a black box our customers cannot see or understand.
  
  
Our Internet and cloud intelligence platform delivers the only collectively powered real-time view of the Internet and private networks, cloud, and SaaS platforms, helping enterprises and service providers identify problems before they impact revenue, damage brand reputation, or halt employee productivity.
  
  
In August 2020, Cisco Systems completed the acquisition of ThousandEyes, which now forms the ThousandEyes Business Unit within the Cisco Networking Business Group and is the Network Assurance solution for Cisco across the Cisco Networking Cloud and Cisco Security Cloud. ThousandEyes is also a foundational component of Cisco’s growing Full-Stack Observability "FS") business.
  
  
About The Role
  
We're all familiar with the technology, but have you ever wondered how the Internet actually works? At ThousandEyes, we spend every day working to help customers understand the gotchas of Internet-based service delivery: how to identify problems, how to resolve, and how to avoid them in the future. Our Customer Engineering team is tasked with empowering our customers with ThousandEyes to ease their performance monitoring pains.
  
  
If you enjoy variety in job responsibilities, this is the job for you. A day may involve helping a customer identify network loss in an undersea cable, diagnose the cause of a route leak impacting significant portions of internet traffic, scripting an approach to monitoring a website's login flow, spinning up a lab environment to reproduce a strange set of behaviors seen in a customer's environment, saving a company hours of bridge time during a significant outage impacting their infrastructure by finding the smoking-gun in a network outage, or simply helping someone understand the way that our applications work. The job is highly variable and requires both the ability to make data-driven decisions, and draw conclusions based on incomplete information. We're looking for out-of-the-box thinkers who can complement and extend the already formidable talents of our Customer Engineering organization.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  

* Provide advanced technical expertise and leadership in solving complex, high-impact customer issues
* Lead the creation, refinement, and delivery of technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge content
* Partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to address systemic product issues and influence roadmap decisions
* Guide and mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and team development
* Submit and manage effective escalations, coach others on how to engage with Engineering and Product teams
* Utilize advanced software skills to configure, troubleshoot, or automate ThousandEyes product workflow
* Drive serviceability, usability, and product improvement efforts through customer feedback and technical insights
* Represent the support function in cross-functional meetings and customer engagements
* Contribute proactively to digital transformation by creating scripts, automation tools, and reusable assets
* Promote ThousandEyes' culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence
* Timely interaction with customers and internal teams requesting support via online-chat, email and phone
* Active participation in 24x7 Support Coverage model

Qualifications
  

* A standout"customer firs" attitude
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 4-7 + years of experience in a technical support, engineering, or related customer-facing role
* Specialist-level certifications (e.g. CCNP) or equivalent advance technical credentials preferred
* Experience with Cloud/SaaS software products is highly desirable
* Familiar with core networking principles - TCP/IP, DNS, web technologies, proxies and VoIP
* Working knowledge of virtualization technology - containers, virtualBox, VMware, HyperV, Xen
* Working knowledge in security - authentication, permissions, SSO
* Knowledge of one computer languages and programming (Java, Python, XML, RESTAPI) frameworks desirable
* Experience with the administration of Linux based Operations Systems a plus
* Experience in technical writing is a plus
* Ability to prioritize& complete tasks in a timely fashion
* Ability to communicate clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical users
* Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Expert in one or more technical domains; broad knowledge across ThousandEyes and networking technologies
* Proficient in automation, programmability, orchestration, virtualization, and/or security
* Reads and applies industry standards, RFCs, and architectural documents
* Mentors team members and drives team goals into actionable initiatives
* Influences product development through trends analysis and cross-functional collaboration
* Regional or global impact; regularly interacts with customers, leadership, and product teams
* Leads original and creative initiatives that are critical to organization success

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

As a Cloud Platform Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), you will support and enhance our cloud environment, ensuring scalability, high availability, security, and cost-efficiency. Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Stay current with GCP innovations and evaluate new services for potential adoption.

* Propose and implement improvements to enhance performance, security, and developer experience.

  
  

**Required Skills:**

  

Experience

* Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience with GCP services.

  
  

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of GCP services: Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, VPC, Cloud Interconnect, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Network Connectivity Center (NCC), Workload Identity Federation (WIF).

* Experience with Terraform and YAML for Infrastructure as Code.

* Networking knowledge: VPC design, VPN, Cloud NAT, Interconnect, Peering, firewall rules and policies.

* Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (GKE).

* Experience with Python for various applications.

* Experience with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Agile methodologies.

  
  

Certifications

* Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer or other relevant GCP certifications.

  
  

Soft Skills

* Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

* Communication and collaboration abilities.

* Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies.

description:

* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.




**Disclaimer:**
===============

  

Finastra has signed an agreement to sell its Universal Banking business to Pollen Street Capital, with completion expected end 2026 / early 2027, subject to consultation and customary closing conditions. Upon completion, this role is expected to transition to the standalone Universal Banking business, creating opportunities to support its future growth and success.

Introduction

The Universal Banking Finastra Cloud is supported by a global cloud infrastructure leveraging Microsoft Azure technologies, system integrators and solution partners delivering Finastra Universal Banking solutions intended for the highest level of security, performance and operating excellence.

Application Techincal Operations group will be resposible for monitoring and administrating end-to-end Cloud Core Banking solution for multiple customers around the world, esuring Infrastructur & Application monitoring, implementing planned activities to upgrade the applications working collaboratively with multiple technical groups from Product, DevOps, Global Services and Customer Support.

Responsibilities

As a Senior System Engineer for Cloud, your key responsibilities will include:

* **Infrastructure Management:** Deploy and manage Azure Virtual Machines (Linux RHEL 8.x, 9.X) and PaaS services (storage accounts, key vaults, Azure Web App, ADF, Azure SQL databases) using DevOps pipelines **.**

* **AKS and Container Operations:** Implement, configure, operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain containerized applications and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.

* **Application Operations:** Install and configure new releases, service packs, patches, and hot-fixes for Core Banking Solutions via Azure DevOps pipelines.

* **Incident and Event Management:** Investigate and troubleshoot technical issues and incidents in live or implementation client environments, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to SLAs.

* Integration Management: Configure and maintain integrations of the Core Banking solution.

* Automation: Develop and maintain scripts for operational task automation.

* **Access Management:** Administer access management using Finastra Corporate Access Management tools.

* **Service Reviews:** Participate in periodic service reviews, providing updates and recommendations for improvements.

* **Knowledge Management:** Create, review, and update knowledge-based articles in the Application Operations repository.

* **Proactive Monitoring:** Collect and evaluate application performance metrics, providing feedback to Product & QA teams.

* **Innovation and Improvement:** Drive innovation by adopting new cloud monitoring technologies and identifying operational tasks for monitoring and automating self-healing.

* **Collaboration:** Work closely with Universal Banking business units to enhance monitoring practices and service improvements.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* **Experience:** 4-6 years of hands-on experience in public cloud infrastructure and services (preferably Microsoft Azure).
* **Technical Skills:**

* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, particularly with RHEL 8.x and 9.x.
* **Must-have:** Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Kubernetes, and container technologies, including deployment, configuration, monitoring, security, scaling, upgrades, and troubleshooting.

* + Experience with Azure cloud PaaS services (Azure Data Factory, Microsoft SQL, storage accounts, load balancers).

* + Knowledge of IT operations, High Availability, and Disaster Recovery architectures.

* + Basic networking knowledge and troubleshooting skills.

* + Expertise in monitoring platforms like Site24x7 and Grafana.

* + Experience in database technologies (Oracle, MS SQLServer, PostgreSQL).
  + scripting languages (Perl, Python, Korn Shell, Windows batch).
  + middleware (Apache Tomcat, IIS Server, Java technologies, JBoss EAP).

* + Experience with DevOps technologies, preferably Azure DevOps.

* **Soft Skills:**

* + Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* + Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* + Customer-centric mindset with a focus on service delivery.

* + Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks with minimal supervision.
  + Agile and collaborative working style.

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health & Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

* Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

title: Senior Engineer, Virtualization
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.** Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

### **Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities  

Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues  
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure

* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

Assess customer environments for performance, capacity, configuration, design, resilience, security, and supportability issues; propose and implement resolutions  

* Provide architectural oversight and validate that proposed changes, designs, and remediation plans align with vendor-supported practices, client standards, capacity, resiliency, security, and service scope

* Work across networking, storage, operating-system, security, monitoring, automation, and application teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues

Work with vendors and hardware partners to resolve virtualization and compute issues, coordinate escalations, and implement supported resolutions  

* Own or contribute to problem-management records, corrective actions, preventive actions, post-incident reviews, and technical root-cause analyses for recurring or systemic issues

Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management  

Maintain accurate client architecture, access, configuration, monitoring, hardware, firmware, inventory, and maintenance documentation. Reconcile documentation against authoritative platform, CMDB, monitoring, and inventory sources  
* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices

Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency  

Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews  
Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review  
* Provide clear technical context, risk, impact, dependencies, recommended actions, and next steps to Client Success Managers and customer technical contacts. Business-impacting or scope-related customer communications should be coordinated through the appropriate Client Success Manager

* Participate in 24x7 operations and the on-call rotation, including major incidents and planned maintenance activities as scheduled

Complete training and certification as assigned to further skills and knowledge  

* Mentor L2 engineers, improve escalation quality, review technical work when assigned, and contribute to standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives

### **Qualifications/ Technology Experience**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Unique education, specialized experience, skills, knowledge, training, or certification may be substituted)  

* 10+ yrs of experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure operations
* + Experience with VMware vSphere/VVF required
  + Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required
  + Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
  Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployment, configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support
* + Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
  + Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
  + Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
  + Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required
Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred  
* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required  
Managed Services or consulting experience required  
VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred  
* ITILv4 certification preferred

### **Qualifications: Soft Skills**

Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities  

* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset

Superior customer service and training skills  

* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events

Ability to work without direct supervision and make sound technical decisions  

Team-oriented collaborator willing to share knowledge and experience  
Ability to communicate technical risk, business impact, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions clearly to engineers, managers, CSMs, vendors, and customer technical stakeholders  
Ability to remain accountable for coordination and follow-through until the next owner formally accepts an escalation  
* Ability to balance customer requests with platform capacity, resiliency, security, contractual scope, change control, and operational risk

Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain collaborative and positive working relationships at all levels  

Ability to effectively interact with all levels of business via phone, written communication, and in person  
Skilled in achieving results in a customer centric environment  
* Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced 24x7 managed-services environment

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work-life balance

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

**Inclusive and people-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: GM - Projects and service partner management
description:
Job Description:

**About the Education Segment**

Schneider Electric's Education Segment provides technical training solutions that close the skills gap in energy, automation and digital technologies. We equip technical and vocational institutes, universities, government skilling programmes and industry academies with hands-on training labs, curricula, digital learning, train-the-trainer programmes and certification.

Demand is rising fast. Governments are investing heavily in workforce skilling, industry faces acute technician shortages, and the energy transition and smart manufacturing need new skills at scale. The segment has already helped more than 200,000 young people gain job-ready skills.

We are building a dedicated delivery organisation in India, combining in-house experts with a network of certified local service partners. Service partners are essential to how we serve institutions in every state, reliably and close to the customer.

**Purpose of the role**

Build, develop and manage the Education Segment's network of service partners across India. You will make sure that every institution, in every state, can count on qualified local partners to install, commission and support its training solutions.

You will select and certify partners, build their capabilities, manage their performance and make the partner model a reliable, scalable extension of our own delivery team.

**Market overview**

India has one of the world's largest and fastest-growing technical training markets. National skilling programmes, the modernisation of ITIs, polytechnics and engineering colleges, and rapid growth in manufacturing, energy and digital infrastructure are creating strong demand for industry-grade training solutions.

Institutions across India expect solutions delivered to schedule, trainers ready to teach, and reliable local support for many years. This calls for a strong delivery organisation backed by a network of capable local partners.

**Key responsibilities**

**Build the partner network**

* Map partner needs by state and region, based on where institutions are and where projects are planned.
* Identify, assess and select service partners with the right technical skills, coverage and quality standards.
* Agree partner contracts, scope of work and service levels with procurement, legal and the operations centre.

**Certification and capability**

* Run onboarding and certification programmes for partner engineers and trainers, working with master trainers and engineering.
* Keep partners up to date as new training solutions are launched, through refresher training and technical documentation.
* Make sure partners follow our health, safety, quality and compliance standards on every site.

**Partner performance**

* Assign partners to projects and service requests, balancing workload, skills and location.
* Track partner performance on quality, timeliness, safety and customer feedback; run regular reviews and improvement plans.
* Recognise and grow high-performing partners; address under-performance quickly.

**Customer satisfaction and services**

* Make sure partner work meets institutions' expectations and contributes to high customer satisfaction.
* Support the growth of services through partners: maintenance contracts, spare parts, upgrades and train-the-trainer programmes.
* Act as the escalation point for partner-related issues raised by institutions or project teams.

**Processes and tools**

* Set up clear processes, tools and reporting for partner management, work orders and service tickets.
* Share lessons from the field with the delivery and engineering teams to improve products and processes.

(External) English Qualifications:  

* 8–12 years in field services, service partner or channel management, preferably with industrial, electrical or automation equipment.
* Proven experience building and managing a multi-state partner network in India, including selection, contracting, certification and performance management.
* Good technical understanding of installation, commissioning and maintenance of engineered equipment.
* Strong focus on quality, safety and customer satisfaction.
* Organised and data-driven, with experience of service management tools and reporting.
* Excellent communicator and negotiator, comfortable working with partners, institutions and internal teams.
* Engineering degree or diploma; additional qualification in management a plus. English and Hindi; other Indian languages an advantage.
* Willing to travel frequently across India.

Bring your project leadership expertise to a team that values impact and excellence — apply today!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

title: ASIC Engineer, Design
description:
The Infra Silicon team at Meta is responsible for designing and building in-house hardware accelerator Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs) to enhance Meta's computing with superior capacity and efficiency at lower power and cost. The team focuses on creating domain-specific System on Chips (SoCs) that enable Meta's data centers to execute computationally-intensive workloads, such as video transcoding and AI/ML, with higher performance and lower energy consumption. They are organized into several key areas, including architecture & algorithms, design & micro-architecture, design verification, implementation & backend design, emulation/prototyping, and system on chip (SoC), which collaborate extensively with other teams to deliver comprehensive solutions for various technical domains.  
  
  

### **ASIC Engineer, Design Responsibilities:**

* Architecture exploration
* Micro-architecture development
* Soft and hard IP identification, selection and integration
* Collaboration with verification and emulation teams in test plan development and debug
* Collaboration with implementation team to close the design on timing and power

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of silicon development experience with experience of first-pass success in ASIC (Application-Specific Integrated Circuit) Development
* Experience in one of these skills: Micro-architecture and RTL development for complex control and data path IPs (Intellectual Properties), OR Experience in SoC (System on Chip) Micro-architecture, Design and Integration, OR Implementation, Power methodology development
* Experience with Verilog or System Verilog
* Lint, CDC (Clock Domain Crossing), Synthesis and Power Optimization

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working across multiple projects
* Experience with scripting languages (TCL, Python, Perl, Shell-scripting)
* Experience in CPU, NOC (Network on Chip), Memory and Peripheral Subsystems
* Experience with Power Analysis and Optimization
* Experience in data path development
* Experience in HLS (High-Level Synthesis)
* Experience with Synthesis, Timing Closure and Formal Verification Methodology
* 15+ years of experience in silicon development

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

title: Senior Client Platform Engineer
description:

This role will serve as a senior technical engineer and subject matter expert responsible for the engineering, security, automation, and lifecycle management of Finastra's endpoint platforms and services across the organization.

  

The successful candidate will drive the strategy, modernization, and operational excellence of endpoint technologies supporting Windows, macOS, iOS, and other client platforms. While a significant focus of this role will be on Apple technologies and their continued adoption across the enterprise, the engineer will also support broader endpoint management, security, compliance, and user experience initiatives.

  

Working closely with Endpoint Security, Security Engineering, Service Management, and Support teams, you will play a key role in shaping the future of endpoint management, device security, workplace automation, and modern end-user computing services.

This role is ideal for an experienced endpoint engineer who combines deep Apple expertise with broad endpoint management, security, and automation capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Platform Ownership**

* Drive platform modernization initiatives focused on automation, security, operational efficiency, and user experience.

Act as a senior escalation point and subject matter expert for endpoint management technologies and services.  

**Endpoint Management & Device Lifecycle**

* Design and maintain automated provisioning, deployment, and device management processes.
* Support hardware refresh programs, lifecycle governance, and platform standardization initiatives.

**Operating System & Application Management**

* Package, deploy, and manage enterprise applications.
* Maintain application compatibility and supportability across endpoint environments.
* Develop deployment standards, release management processes, and endpoint configuration baselines.
* Partner with business and technology teams to support application modernization initiatives.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain endpoint security baselines and compliance standards.
* Partner with security teams to support vulnerability management, remediation, and endpoint risk reduction initiatives.
* Support deployment and management of enterprise security tools across endpoint devices.
* Assist with regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements while ensuring alignment with corporate security policies and standards.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Support integration between endpoint platforms and enterprise identity services.
* Manage integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and device compliance policies.
* Support modern device identity, Zero Trust, and secure access initiatives.

**Automation & Engineering**

* Develop automation solutions using scripting, APIs, and platform-native capabilities.
* Build proactive remediation, self-healing, and operational automation solutions.
* Integrate endpoint management platforms with enterprise systems and workflows.
* Develop reporting and operational dashboards to support platform management and decision-making.

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

* Monitor endpoint health, security, compliance, operational performance, and user experience metrics.
* Drive continuous service improvement, automation, and platform maturity initiatives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures.
Participate in audits, governance reviews, technology assessments, and platform roadmap planning.  

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5-7+ years of experience engineering and managing enterprise endpoint platforms.
* 4+ years of hands-on Apple platform administration and engineering experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune, Kandji, Jamf, or comparable endpoint management platforms.
* Strong understanding of Windows and Apple device management within enterprise environments.
* Experience managing endpoint security, compliance controls, vulnerability remediation, and device lifecycle services.
* Experience supporting operating system management, software deployment, and endpoint update management.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
* Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity and security services.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.
* Experience integrating Apple devices with Entra ID and Conditional Access.
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management practices.
* Experience supporting enterprise security tooling and vulnerability management programs.
* Experience within highly regulated and global enterprise environments.
* Apple, Microsoft, or endpoint management certifications.
* Experience supporting cloud-first workplace and endpoint modernization initiatives

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

description:

The mechanical& thermal team is an integrated part of HW organization, responsible for varieties of complex electro-mechanical designs, which includes but are not limited to central office networking products (product ranges from 1RU to 40RU sizes), outdoor mobility equipment, high performance thermal solutions and complex PCB assemblies.

* May lead small scale mechanical engineering projects (one to two features) with manageable risks and resource requirements and may take on project management responsibilities

Bachelors + 10-14 years of related experience, or Masters + 8-10 years of related experience, or PhD + 6-8 years of related experience

* Hands on Experience in using AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Hands on knowledge on using Thermal testing tools with available DAQ’s in the market, Environmental chambers.
* Proficient in creating test plans, executing tests, and reporting results.

* Capable of setting up tests, system bring-up and troubleshooting issues with minimal assistance.
* Familiar with MDVT, EDVT, airflow, acoustics and environmental testing for networking products.

description:

The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across ATU, STU, and CSU to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.

Using deep technical expertise across Databricks solutions and Microsoft Azure Data, Infrastructure, and AI services, you will lead partner and customer technical discussions, resolve blockers that affect customer success projects, and accelerate consumption. You will collaborate with Cloud Solution Architects, Customer Success Account Managers, Engineering, and Partner Development teams to drive measurable customer and partner outcomes. This role offers an opportunity to strengthen your technical leadership, expand your cloud expertise, and accelerate your career growth.  
  
This role is ideal for a technically credible, customer-focused architect who can connect Databricks capabilities with Microsoft Azure platform strengths to accelerate adoption, remove technical blockers, and deliver measurable customer and partner outcomes.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Customer and partner success

* Guide customers and partners in implementing best practices for security, governance, reliability, performance, and operational excellence.
* Identify and resolve technical blockers that impact solution deployment, scalability, adoption, or customer success outcomes.

Solution architecture and technical leadership  

* Design, validate, and optimize enterprise-scale architectures leveraging Databricks, Azure Data Services, AI Services, and cloud-native technologies.

Partner ecosystem and industry leadership  

* Collaborate with Databricks, Microsoft Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product, and Partner teams to drive successful customer outcomes and adoption at scale.
* Lead virtual teams to address complex technical challenges and deliver cross-functional solutions.
* Represent Microsoft and Databricks in customer engagements, industry events, technical communities, and field enablement activities.
* Share customer and partner insights with Product and Engineering teams to influence product strategy and drive continuous improvement.

Consumption and business growth  

* Drive Azure consumption, Databricks adoption, and customer success metrics across assigned accounts and partner engagements.
* Help partners develop and scale differentiated solutions and services that create customer value and accelerate cloud adoption.
* Collaborate with partner technical and sales teams to identify growth opportunities and expand the adoption of Microsoft Data, Analytics, and AI solutions.

Continuous learning and innovation  

* Maintain deep expertise in Databricks, Azure, Data & AI technologies, industry trends, and competitive offerings.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset through continuous learning, technical skilling, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to Microsoft and Databricks thought leadership through technical insights, customer success stories, and best-practice development.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications:  

* 6+ years customer-facing technical sales experience.

title: Backup Engineer (Rubrik Platform)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Role Overview**

The Backup Engineer (Rubrik Platform) is responsible for the end-to-end design, implementation, operation, and optimization of backup and recovery services within Haleon’s global infrastructure landscape. The role ensures data protection, cyber resilience, and recoverability across hybrid environments spanning Azure cloud regions, manufacturing sites (Edge), and enterprise workloads.

  

The engineer will operate the Rubrik Cloud Data Management (CDM) platform, including virtual clusters, physical appliances (Edge), and Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC), ensuring consistent execution of backup, replication, recovery, and compliance requirements.

This role is critical to supporting business continuity, ransomware resilience, and regulatory compliance, enabling secure and rapid restoration of services across Haleon’s global estate.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Backup Architecture & Engineering**

* Design and implement a scalable backup and recovery architecture using Rubrik CDM across:
  + Azure virtual clusters.
  + On-premise Rubrik “Brik” appliances.
  + Edge appliances at manufacturing sites.
  + Rubrik Cloud Vault (offsite third copy).
* Define and enforce:
  + Backup strategies (full, incremental, snapshot-based).
  + Retention and archival policies.
  + Replication and disaster recovery design (site-to-cloud/region-to-region).
* Configure integration with enterprise platforms:
  + VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF).
  + VMWare (vCenter).
  + Windows/Linux servers.
  + SQL/Oracle/Postgres Databases.
  + Active Directory.
  + Microsoft 365 and enterprise applications.
Continuously assess the platform architecture and improve performance, scalability, and resilience.  

  

**Administration & Operations (Engineering Support)**

* Engineer and ensure that the Operations teams maintain:
  + Rubrik clusters (Azure and on-premise).
  + Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC) for centralized management.
  + Backup agents (RBS and others where applicable).
* Support Operations in executing daily operational activities:
  + Backup scheduling and job monitoring.
  + Failure analysis and re-runs.
  + Capacity and storage management.
Ensure system availability and performance across all Rubrik environments.  

  

**Monitoring, Alerting & Incident Management**

* Configure and manage monitoring:
* Backup success/failure rates.
  + Cluster health and hardware metrics.
  + Replication and archival jobs.
* Enable proactive alerting for anomalies and failures.
* Act as escalation point for backup incidents:
  + Troubleshoot failures and performance issues.
  + Support in performing root cause analysis.
  Implement corrective and preventive actions.

  

**Data Protection & Recovery Assurance**

* Perform and validate:
  + Backup integrity checks.
  + Restore testing (file-level, VM-level, application-level where applicable).
  + Disaster recovery and replication failover tests.
* Ensure RPO/RTO targets are met for all critical workloads.
Support user acceptance testing (UAT) for backup and recovery processes.  

  

**Security & Ransomware Resilience**

* Engineer, implement and maintain:
  + Backup immutability (e.g., Azure immutable blob/CCES where applicable).
  + Role-based access control and privileged access governance.
  + Encryption and secure communication configurations.
* Support integration with Rubrik security capabilities such as:
  + Anomaly Detection.
  + Ransomware protection and recovery workflows.
  Rubrik Cloud Vault.

  

**Integration & Infrastructure Alignment**

* Work with adjacent engineering teams to integrate backup services into:
  + Azure networking (VLANs, subnets, DNS, firewall rules).
  + Identity and access systems (CyberArk/SailPoint).
  + CMDB and change management processes.
* Validate network connectivity and infrastructure prerequisites:
  + Cluster communication.
  + RSC connectivity.
  + RCV connectivity.
  Replication paths.

  

**Change, Configuration & Compliance (Engineering Support)**

* Maintain all Rubrik assets in CMDB:
  + Clusters, nodes, and appliances.
  + Software versions and configurations.
* Execute changes in line with:
  + Change Management procedures.
  + Security and compliance controls.
* Support audits by providing:
  + Backup evidence.
  + Recovery validation reports.
  Compliance documentation.

  

**Documentation & Knowledge Management**

* Develop and maintain:
  + Runbooks and SOPs for backup and recovery operations.
  + Architecture diagrams and platform qualification documentation.
Provide knowledge transfer and operational readiness documentation for BAU teams.  

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Collaborate with:
  + Infrastructure teams (Windows/Linux/VMware).
  + Cloud engineering teams (Azure).
  + Security and risk teams (DTIS).
  + Application owners.
* Translate business requirements into actionable backup strategies.
Provide advisory support on data protection best practices.

**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Job Description:** OBSv2 to AWS S3 Migration Platform Engineer
  
Role Purpose
  
Lead the design, build, and operation of a secure, scalable migration platform to move object data from OBSv2 to AWS S3. The role focuses on reliable execution, automation, governance, monitoring, and production support for large-scale enterprise data migration.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own the end-to-end migration workflow from OBSv2 source buckets to AWS S3 destination buckets.
* Build and operate AWS-based orchestration using Step Functions, Lambda, Fargate, AWS Batch, DynamoDB, SQS, and rclone.
* Support both manifest-based and dynamic migration approaches, including batching, sharding, task sizing, and retry handling.
* Implement governance for bandwidth allocation, queue management, prioritization, throttling, and job tracking.
* Build observability through CloudWatch dashboards, logs, metrics, alerts, health checks, and progress reporting.
* Support secure multi-account deployment, IAM controls, privacy safeguards, testing, performance tuning, and production cutover.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Expected Deliverables
  

* Production-ready migration orchestration platform supporting both manifest and no-manifest paths.
* Hub-side governance for bandwidth control, queue processing, throttling, and completion reporting.
* Reusable rclone-based migration runtime with progress reporting and dynamic throttle support.
* DynamoDB-backed job, task, queue, bandwidth, and summary state management.
* CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, logs, runbooks, deployment automation, and operational documentation.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Preferred Experience
  

* Experience with Dell ECS, OBSv2, or other S3-compatible enterprise object storage platforms.
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale migrations in regulated, production environments.
* Experience with hub-and-spoke operating models across multiple AWS accounts.
* Ability to produce clear technical documentation and leadership-ready reporting.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Mandatory Technical Skills
  
Skill Area Mandatory Skill Requirement
  
AWS Serverless Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, SSM Parameter Store, and Secrets Manager.
  
AWS Compute and Containers Strong working knowledge of ECS Fargate, AWS Batch, container task definitions, sidecar patterns, resource sizing, and runtime environment configuration.
  
AWS Storage Deep understanding of Amazon S3, S3 Intelligent-Tiering, S3-compatible APIs, object metadata, prefix structures, large object transfers, and lifecycle considerations.
  
Object Storage Migration Experience migrating large object datasets from on-premises or S3-compatible platforms such as Dell ECS/OBSv2 to AWS S3.
  
rclone Hands-on experience configuring and operating rclone for high-volume transfers, including transfers, checkers, retries, checksum validation, no-traverse behavior, stats, logs, and bandwidth limiting.
  
Python Development Strong Python skills for Lambda and Fargate services, including boto3, JSON processing, exception handling, logging, dataclasses, streaming files, and API integration.
  
DynamoDB Ability to design and operate DynamoDB tables, keys, indexes, scans, updates, batch writes, Decimal handling, and state-management patterns.
  
Networking Understanding of AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPCs, private subnets, routing, S3 Gateway Endpoints, NAT Gateway scoping, and high-throughput network design.
  
IAM and Security Strong knowledge of IAM roles, cross-account access, STS assume-role, API keys, Secrets Manager, least-privilege design, and secure operational access.
  
Observability Experience with CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, structured logging, operational telemetry, and migration progress reporting.
  
CI/CD and Deployment Experience with GitLab repositories, CI/CD pipelines, environment-specific configuration, infrastructure deployment, and safe teardown procedures.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
Know-How Skills and Domain Understanding
  

* Understand large-scale object storage migration patterns, including manifests, prefix-based partitioning, batching, and validation.
* Balance migration performance across data volume, object count, compute resources, network capacity, and rclone concurrency.
* Design fair bandwidth allocation, throttling, queue handling, retry, and escalation models for production migrations.
* Apply strong operational discipline across monitoring, runbooks, restart procedures, completion checks, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, architecture notes, input contracts, implementation details, and support procedures.

R&D Service Engineer

### **Job Description**

**R&D Service Engineer**

Join our global Level 3 (L3) Technical Support organization and serve as a key database expert, helping resolve complex, business-critical issues in large-scale healthcare production environments.

**Your role:**

* Provide advanced Oracle database support for critical customer escalations and complex production incidents, acting as the highest level of database expertise within Support.
* Troubleshoot database performance, availability, and configuration issues using tools such as Automatic Workload Repository (AWR), Active Session History (ASH), SQL traces, execution plans, and database performance statistics.

* Support major customer activities including upgrades, migrations, failovers, go-lives, and other business-critical events while participating in a 24x7 on-call rotation.

* You’ve acquired strong 7-10 yrs hands-on experience with Oracle Enterprise Database: Oracle 19c and older Oracle versions
* Your skills include SQL and PL/SQL development, database performance tuning, and advanced troubleshooting using AWR, ASH, SQL Trace, execution plans, and Oracle dynamic performance views.
* You have a strong understanding of database architecture, including sessions, locking, memory management, storage, connectivity, and performance optimization.

* You’re an analytical problem solver with experience handling critical production incidents, customer escalations, and cross-functional investigations spanning database, application, operating system, storage, and network layers.
