title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Meet the Team
  
Join a team that's helping some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation. You'll partner closely with customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
You'll work on some of the most challenging AI deployments in the industry, partnering with Fortune 100 organizations to bring cutting-edge AI systems into production. Every engagement influences not only customer success, but also the future direction of the product. If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
**As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:**  

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 7+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications, or Masters + 4 years of related experience, or PhD + 1 year of related experience.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Identity Architect
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com .

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**  
  
As an Identity Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, administering, supporting, and modernizing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services, including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and cryptographic key management solutions. The role focuses on enhancing security, automating certificate operations, ensuring compliance, and delivering scalable certificate-based authentication and encryption services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.

**Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments, including Microsoft Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), Registration Authorities (RA), Online Responders, and certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Manage certificate issuance, renewal, revocation, validation, and recovery processes for users, servers, applications, devices, and non-human identities.
* Design, implement, and maintain PKI architectures, certificate templates, certificate policies, trust hierarchies, and cryptographic standards aligned with business and security requirements.
* Support enterprise certificate lifecycle management solutions, automating certificate enrolment, renewal, discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Administer and maintain Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), cryptographic key management systems, key backup procedures, and secure key storage practices.
* Support digital certificate deployments across servers, applications, web services, databases, network devices, cloud services, VPNs, and authentication platforms.
* Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication solutions, including Smart Cards, FIDO, device certificates, Wi-Fi authentication, VPN authentication, and mutual TLS (mTLS).
* Monitor PKI infrastructure health, certificate expiration risks, cryptographic compliance, and security vulnerabilities to ensure continuous service availability.
* Perform PKI assessments, health checks, audits, security reviews, remediation activities, and modernization initiatives aligned with industry best practices.
* Support cloud-based PKI solutions, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, Azure Key Vault, and integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and security platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell and related scripting technologies to simplify certificate lifecycle management and operational activities.
* Maintain PKI documentation, operational procedures, governance standards, audit evidence, and compliance requirements supporting regulatory and security obligations.

  

**Required Qualifications:**

8 to 12+ years of hands-on experience managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) environments and certificate lifecycle management solutions.  

Strong practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate templates, certificate enrollment, and certificate lifecycle processes.  
Demonstrated hands-on expertise in:  
* Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) design and administration.  

  Certificate Authorities, Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), and certificate trust chains.  
  Cryptographic concepts including public/private keys, digital signatures, encryption, hashing algorithms, and key management.  
  Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Azure Key Vault, and cryptographic key protection mechanisms.  
  Certificate-based authentication, TLS/SSL, mutual TLS (mTLS), code signing, and secure communications.
Experience implementing certificate lifecycle management solutions and certificate automation across enterprise environments.  
Experience supporting cloud and hybrid PKI environments integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, Azure services, and enterprise security platforms.  
Strong knowledge of certificate governance, compliance requirements, cryptographic standards, and security best practices.  
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation for PKI administration, certificate management, and reporting.  
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills within complex enterprise environments.  
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, capable of working with technical and non-technical stakeholders .
  

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with DigiCert, Keyfactor, AppViewX, Venafi, Microsoft Cloud PKI, or similar certificate lifecycle management platforms.  

Experience with Microsoft Intune certificate deployment (SCEP/PKCS), Azure Key Vault, HSM technologies, cryptographic key management, and enterprise PKI governance.  
Experience implementing certificate automation, non-human identity (NHI) management, machine identity security, and PKI modernization initiatives.  
Knowledge of Zero Trust, modern identity security, certificate-based authentication, quantum-safe cryptography trends, and cloud security architectures.  
* Microsoft certifications such as SC-300, AZ-500, AZ-104, or relevant PKI/security certifications; healthcare or other regulated industry experience is a plus.
  

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

* Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
* Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
* Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

* BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
* Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System
* Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.

* Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
* Proficient in written and verbal communication.
* Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

3 to 10 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

description:
Hardware EngineerThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

***Job Family Definition:***

Designs, analyses, develops, modifies and evaluates electrical/electronic parts, components, sub-systems, algorithms, or integrated circuitry for Routers (access, edge and core) and Ethernet Switches. Conducts feasibility studies, design margin and validation analyses and empirical testing on new and modified designs. Assists in architecture development and assessment. Evaluates reliability of materials, properties, designs, and techniques used in production. May direct support personnel in the preparation of detailed design, design testing and prototype fabrication.

***Management Level Definition:***

Hardware Engineering Team under Networking BU is working on the most leading edge technologies for Routers and Ethernet Switches used in Hyperscale Data Centres for AI, Service Providers, Enterprise Networks. Team is responsible for end-to-end design and development of solutions.

Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Visible contributions improve time-to-market, achieve cost reductions, or satisfy current and future unmet customer needs. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. Leads or participates in cross-functional initiatives and contributes to mentorship and knowledge sharing across the organization.

**What you’ll do:**

***Responsibilities:***

* Owning End-to-End responsibility of designing and delivering the product
* Working closely with PLM Team, understanding the Market Requirements and coming-up with architecture details
* Defining architecture, product description details, authoring hardware functional specifications
* Complete Hardware Design Flow – Schematic Entry, selecting components, working with various teams – eCAD, PCB Layout, SI, Power, Mechanical, Thermal, FPGA
* Specifying PCB Stack, working with PCB vendors, supply chain and manufacturing teams
* Working with CM and/or ODM and taking the product through complete lifecycle – proto to production
* Hardware Bring-up, testing, supporting various test teams – EDVT, MDVT, EMC, HALT, SI, IEEE
* Working closely with Diagnostic Software Team for design validation and manufacturing testing.

· Working with Software, Software Test Teams, debugging complex system issues.·

Develops organization-wide architectures and methodologies for electrical hardware design and development across multiple platforms and organizations within the Global Business Unit.

* Identifies and evaluates new technologies, innovations, and outsourced development partner relationships for alignment with technology roadmap and business value; creates plans for integration and update into architecture.
* Reviews and evaluates designs and project activities for compliance with technology and development guidelines and standards; integrates suggestions, updates, and innovations into overall architecture and leads platform architecture process across business.
* Leverages recognized domain expertise, business acumen, and experience to influence decisions of executive business leadership, outsourced development partners, and industry standards groups.
* Provides guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members to set an example of electrical hardware design and development innovation and excellence.

**What you need to bring:**

***Education and Experience Required:***

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering.
* Typically 6+ years experience

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Using electrical design tools and software packages.
* Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
* Experience in designing hardware using high speed serial interface with speed of 50G, 100G with NRZ, PAM4
* Experience with x86 CPU architecture
* Experience designing high layer count boards(18+) including 50G+ signals, and advanced PCB manufacturing technologies
* Experience working with multi-phase DC/DC’s for high current, high transient loads
* Experience working with high speed interfaces, such as DDR4, DDR5, LPDDR, PCIe Gen3, PCIe Gen4, NVMe SSD
* Experience in overall architecture of electronic hardware for products and solutions.
* Designing and integrating electronic components, integrated circuitry, and algorithms into overall architecture.
* Evaluating, proposing, and selecting forms of empirical analysis, modeling and testing methodologies to validate component, circuit, and hardware designs and thermal/emissions management to be used across the organization.
* History of innovation with multiple patents in the field of electronics packaging.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
* Ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design proposals and negotiate options at business unit and executive levels.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

The role will work closely with Innovation, Production, Quality, Procurement, and Project teams to ensure products meet technical, quality, reliability, and customer requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Manage and support product lifecycle activities from product introduction through engineering changes and product obsolescence.

* Support Engineering Change Management / Product Change Requests (PCRs) and ensure changes are properly evaluated, documented, approved, and implemented.

* Coordinate with Innovation and manufacturing teams for product modifications, design changes, and localization/indigenization activities.
* Support prototype development, First Article Inspection (FAI), validation, qualification, and type/routine testing.
* Analyse product and field issues and support root-cause analysis (RCA), corrective actions, and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Provide technical support to Production, Quality, Service, and Project teams for product-related issues.
* Coordinate with suppliers for technical clarification, component qualification, alternative components, and supplier-related engineering changes.
* Support electronic/electrical component selection, evaluation, and technical review.
* Review product performance, failure trends, and field feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement and reliability enhancement.
* Ensure product changes comply with applicable customer specifications, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Support preparation of technical responses, test reports, compliance documents, and other documentation required for customer and regulatory approvals.
* Participate in technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders, including customers, suppliers, laboratories, and certification agencies.

Knowledge of Railway industry standards are an advantage.  

In short: People who aspire for more – individuals who are willing to contribute their passion, creativity and skills to help advance our shared vision. Job Title: Senior Security Engineer

Shift Timings: General Shift Role

  

Summary:

The Senior Security Engineer will lead application security engineering across the software development lifecycle. Strong hands-on SAST and DAST scanning experience is required, with primary ownership of DAST operations, SAST engineering, penetration testing, vulnerability remediation and DevSecOps enablement. The role will embed security into design and development, integrate security testing into Secure by Design (SBD), GitHub, Azure and CI/CD workflows, and work closely with development, QA, DevOps, cloud, and product teams to ensure security controls are implemented before production release.

  

Key Responsibilities:

Application Security & Secure by Design

* Embed security requirements, threat considerations, secure coding practices, and control validation across design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.
* Work directly with development teams to identify security gaps early and provide practical remediation guidance while applications are being built.
* Define and maintain security gates, minimum control requirements, exception handling, and evidence expectations for application releases. SAST, DAST & Penetration Testing - Technical Responsibilities
* Own the implementation, configuration, administration, tuning and continuous improvement of enterprise SAST and DAST capabilities.
* Configure, operate and optimize Invicti for authenticated and unauthenticated DAST scans, including scan profiles, authentication, scheduling, coverage, validation, reporting, retesting and troubleshooting.
* Perform SAST scan onboarding and configuration, validate code-level findings, analyze data flows and sources/sinks, tune rules, suppress verified false positives with evidence and provide developer-ready remediation guidance.
* Plan and execute web application, API and network-focused penetration tests using approved methodologies and tools; document reproducible evidence, risk ratings, business impact and corrective actions.
* Triage and correlate SAST, DAST and penetration-testing findings; validate exploitability, remove duplicate or false-positive results, prioritize risk and confirm closure through rescans and retesting.
* Monitor technical scan performance, including scan completion, coverage, authentication success, scan failures, false-positive rates, recurring findings, test effectiveness and remediation trends. DevSecOps, CI/CD, Azure & GitHub Security
* Integrate approved SAST and DAST controls into Secure by Design processes, GitHub repositories, pull requests, build workflows, CI/CD pipelines and release gates.
* Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to implement automated security scans, quality gates, severity thresholds, break-build criteria, and risk-based exception workflows.
* Administer and monitor security controls across GitHub and Azure development environments, including code scanning, secret scanning, dependency alerts, repository security settings, pipeline findings and cloud security configurations.
* Enforce branch protection, mandatory reviews, least-privilege access, environment separation, secure secrets handling and controlled promotion to production.
* Investigate scan and integration failures and retain security evidence for release governance and audit requirements. Vulnerability Management & Remediation
* Manage the end-to-end application vulnerability lifecycle: identification, validation, prioritization, assignment, remediation tracking, retesting, closure and reporting.
* Drive SLA-based remediation with development owners, escalate overdue risks, support documented risk acceptance where justified and verify fixes through rescans or retesting.
* Maintain dashboards and metrics covering vulnerability aging, severity, closure performance, recurrence, scan coverage and application risk posture. Collaboration, Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Act as the application security partner for developers, architects, QA engineers, DevOps teams, product owners, cloud teams and infrastructure teams.
* Deliver secure coding guidance, developer awareness sessions, tool onboarding and knowledge-sharing based on observed vulnerability patterns.
* Contribute to application security standards, procedures, checklists, playbooks, audit evidence and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Evaluate emerging AppSec and DevSecOps capabilities and recommend improvements that increase coverage, automation, accuracy and remediation speed.

  

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related discipline or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum 5–8 years of hands-on cyber security experience, with strong focus on application security, DevSecOps, vulnerability management or penetration testing.

  

Required:

Strong hands-on experience implementing, configuring, operating, tuning and troubleshooting both SAST and DAST solutions in enterprise software development environments.

Hands-on experience with Invicti or a comparable enterprise DAST platform, including authenticated scanning, scan configuration, validation, tuning, reporting, troubleshooting and retesting.

* Hands-on experience integrating security scanning into GitHub pull-request workflows, Azure or equivalent cloud development environments, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Working knowledge of Azure security concepts, GitHub security capabilities, source control governance, secrets management, and secure deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC, common web and API vulnerabilities, risk methodologies. rating, remediation techniques and penetration-testing
* Ability to interpret code-level findings and collaborate with developers on remediation across at least one common language or framework.
* Experience managing remediation SLAs, exceptions, evidence, dashboards, metrics, and stakeholder reporting.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and corrective actions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Skills and Certifications
* Experience with additional SAST, SCA, container, API or cloud-native security tools.
* Exposure to tools and platforms such as GitHub Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or equivalent technologies.
* Familiarity with threat modeling, security architecture reviews, software supply-chain security, SBOM practices, and compliance frameworks.
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CSSLP, , CEH, Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent AppSec / penetration-testing credentials.

* Lead the development of processes and technology frameworks that enable our teams to innovate faster and solve complex technical challenges.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in product operations, supply chain, or engineering leadership within the high-tech industry.
* Proven track record of building and leading high-performing, cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
* Expertise in full product lifecycle management (NPI to EOL) and deep understanding of manufacturing dynamics.
* Advanced ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive strategy without direct authority.
* Outstanding written, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated success in managing complex budgets and operational performance metrics.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Master’s degree in Engineering or an MBA.
* Experience leading large-scale electronics manufacturing operations or hyper-scaler infrastructure programs.
* Certification in Project Management (PMP) or process improvement methodologies (Six Sigma).
* Deep familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and enterprise PLM systems.
* Experience scaling organizations through periods of significant growth or technical transformation.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior/Principal Application Engineer
description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

The Senior/Principal Application Engineer will drive the development of reference designs and application boards with a strong focus on BMS, OBC, DCDC applications in light electric vehicles (LEV) that showcase Nexperia’s portfolio. The person will play a critical role in bridging product development and customer requirements by translating device capabilities into practical, production ready hardware solutions

This role is central to enabling customer adoption and accelerating time-to-market through high-quality design collaterals, hands-on validation and technical support

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, develop, and validate reference designs and application boards using Nexperia’s discrete, analog, and power IC solutions
* Create schematics, perform component selection, and collaborate on PCB layout to optimize performance, efficiency, cost, thermal behavior, and reliability
* Perform comprehensive electrical, thermal, and system-level validation, including efficiency analysis, switching characterization, transient response testing, thermal profiling, and EMI/EMC pre-compliance evaluation and troubleshooting
* Provide application-focused technical support to customers and sales teams by troubleshooting designs, supporting design-in activities, participating in customer engagements, and representing Nexperia at workshops, conferences, and exhibitions
* Create and maintain high-quality technical collateral such as application notes, design guides, simulation models, user manuals, and web-based application content
* Build deep application expertise and translate customer insights into future product opportunities by collaborating with marketing, R&D, and system architects to define requirements, identify use cases, and contribute to product roadmap development

**SKILLS /COMPETENCIES**

Hard Skills:

* Technical experience in PCB design and layout – Altium, KiCad
* Familiarity with simulation tools and industry standards - Matlab/Simulink, LT Spice, Plecs, Thermal analysis, EMC compatibility
* Switching behaviour, losses and efficiency optimization

Soft Skills:

* Strong analytical and system-level thinking
* Hands-on, problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
* Ability to work in cross-functional and global teams
* Customer focused approach with strong ownership
* Excellent presentation and technical writing skills
* English business fluent verbal and written

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS:**

* Education/ studies: BSEE. MSEE preferred
* 5-8 years of experience in application engineering, hardware design or power electronics
* Proven experience developing reference designs or evaluation boards
* Strong knowledge of BMS architectures with all safety measures is advantageous
* Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO26262, UL standards, and AIS is desirable

title: Technical Customer Service Representative
description:
**Technical Customer Service Representative**

**Location:** Hospet, Karnataka  
**Work Arrangement:** Onsite

**What we do at Weir**  
  
We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

**Make your impact**

You’ll play a key role in solving real-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

**What you’ll do**

* **Safety Management:** Follow and promote safety norms as per Weir Group EHS policy and WMI IMS Policy. Facilitate safety trainings, identify hazards, and actively participate in safety activities to ensure a zero-harm environment.
* **Operation & Maintenance Supervision:** Operate and monitor ore crushing, grinding, and size reduction equipment daily. Optimize parameters to achieve desired output and particle size distribution. Conduct process evaluations and troubleshoot operational issues to minimize downtime. Collaborate with metallurgists, plant engineers, and operators to improve throughput and recovery.
* **Performance Analysis:** Perform routine inspections and coordinate maintenance to ensure optimal equipment performance and material flow. Analyze performance data including efficiency, energy consumption, and product quality, preparing detailed technical reports. Implement process control strategies to enhance equipment utilization, productivity, and reduce operational costs.
* **Service Support:** Assist in service activities including maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting to maintain equipment reliability.
* **Management Information Systems (MIS):** Monitor and record process parameters and operational data on a daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly basis to support continuous improvement.
* **Customer & Site Management:** Manage customer relationships, establish process guarantee parameters as per agreements, ensure equipment availability, and meet customer satisfaction targets including Net Promoter Score (NPS) as per headquarters guidelines.
* **Travel Requirements:** Occasional travel may be required to customer sites or other operational locations to support commissioning, maintenance, or customer engagement activities.
* **Safety First:** Demonstrate 100% commitment to our zero harm behaviors in support of our drive towards developing a world-class safety culture.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must-haves:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) in Mineral Processing, Mechanical, or Electrical disciplines.
* 5-7 years of hands-on experience with large mineral processing equipment such as ball mills, crushers, and HPGRs.
* Strong knowledge of hydraulics, electrical systems, and diagnostic/fault-finding tools.
* Proven skills in preventive and predictive maintenance, installation, and commissioning of large equipment.

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Excellent customer and supplier networking and relationship management skills.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with a solution-selling mindset.
* Behavioral competencies including customer focus, collaboration, developing people, performance mindset, building trust, effective communication, good decision-making, and delivering excellence through others.

**Why join Weir?**  
We live our values we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end-to-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

**Benefits**

* Competitive pay
* Career development and learning support
* Access to global inclusion networks
* Regional and team-specific benefits
* Sharebuilder scheme
* Wellness support for you and your family
* Collaboration with global teams
* Study support

Founded in 1871, Weir is a world leading engineering business with a purpose to make mining operations smarter, more efficient and sustainable. Thanks to Weir’s technology, our customers can produce essential metals and minerals using less energy, water and waste at lower cost. With the increasing need for metals and minerals for climate change solutions, Weir colleagues are playing their part in powering a low carbon future. We are a global family of 11,000 uniquely talented people in over 60 counties, inspiring each other to do the best work of our lives.

title: ITOC Team Lead
description:
Overview:
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  

  

With 5,400\+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq\-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world\-class products and services to all types of investors.  

  

Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

 **Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business\-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game\-changing policies.


Responsibilities:
**Job Purpose:**The ITOC Team Leader provides technical leadership for a 24x7x365 IT Operations Center responsible for monitoring, triage, incident coordination, escalation, communication and operational stability across network, infrastructure, cloud, security and business application environments. The role acts as the first point of technical command during production issues, drives timely restoration, ensures accurate stakeholder communication, maintains strong operational discipline and supports continual improvement through automation, runbook maturity, monitoring quality and service reliability metrics.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **24x7 Monitoring \& Event Response:** Lead real\-time monitoring of critical IT services, infrastructure, circuits, servers, storage, virtualization, cloud platforms, security alerts and business applications.
* **Incident Command \& Coordination:** Act as shift\-level incident lead for major alerts or outages, coordinate technical bridges, assign investigation actions, track progress and drive issues toward restoration.
* **Technical Triage \& Troubleshooting:** Perform initial and advanced triage across network, Windows/Linux, virtualization, database, middleware, backup, storage and application layers before escalation.
* **Escalation Ownership:** Engage appropriate Level 2/Level 3 teams, vendors, exchanges, network providers and service owners, while continuing to own the incident until resolution or clear handover.
* **Business \& Stakeholder Communication:** Prepare clear operational updates, outage notifications, awareness messages and resolved communications for service owners, Service Desk and impacted business groups.
* **Shift Leadership \& Handover Quality:** Manage shift priorities, ensure clean shift handovers, maintain situational awareness of active incidents, planned maintenance, pending escalations and operational risks.
* **Runbook \& SOP Management:** Create, review and improve operational runbooks, escalation matrices, alert response procedures and knowledge articles to improve consistency across shifts.
* **Post\-Incident Review Support:** Contribute to incident timelines, impact summaries, root\-cause follow\-up, corrective actions and problem\-management tracking.
* **Operational Reporting \& Metrics:** Track and report key metrics such as alert volumes, incident trends, SLA adherence, MTTA, MTTR, recurring issues, handover quality and automation opportunities.
* **Monitoring Quality \& Alert Hygiene:** Identify noisy, duplicate or low\-value alerts and work with engineering teams to improve thresholds, coverage, routing and actionable alert design.
* **Automation \& Continuous Improvement:** Identify repetitive operational tasks suitable for automation using scripts, APIs, workflows or AI\-assisted tooling; support safe automation adoption with proper controls.
* **Team Mentoring \& KT:** Coach junior ITOC engineers, support onboarding, conduct knowledge\-transfer sessions and promote consistent troubleshooting and communication standards.
* **Change \& Maintenance Support:** Monitor planned changes, validate post\-change service health, support maintenance windows and raise concerns when service risk is observed.
* **Compliance \& Documentation Discipline:** Ensure incidents, escalations, evidence, actions and communications are documented accurately in tickets according to defined policies and SOPs.


Qualifications:
**Experience:** 7\-10 years in ITOC/NOC/SOC, infrastructure operations, network operations, application operations or enterprise monitoring.

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
* **Technical Skills:** ITIL Foundation or higher; CCNA/CCNP; Good understanding of BGP; VMware; Linux/Windows administration certifications, F5 BIG\-IP
* **Tools \-** Datadog, servicenow, solarwinds
* **Domain Exposure:** Experience in financial services, regulated environments, global operations, follow\-the\-sun support and 24x7 support if required.

**Working Environment:**

4 days in office per week

From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. -------------

* Conduct threat hunting, attack emulation, behavioral analytics, and continuous detection coverage assessments while maintaining detection lifecycle governance, quality metrics, release management, and ongoing enhancements.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 6\+ years of experience in Detection Engineering, Threat Hunting, and Security Analytics with demonstrated ownership of the end\-to\-end detection lifecycle, content validation, and cross\-domain threat detection capabilities.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Azure Data Explorer (ADX), KQL, Python, PowerShell, and detection engineering best practices, including analytics development, tuning, testing, and operationalization of security content.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Git, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), Detection\-as\-Code, testing automation, content repositories, platform integrations, peer review processes, and detection release management within SOC environments.
* Experience working with Azure Data Explorer, Databricks, Jupyter/iPython Notebooks, MSTICPy, security data science, statistical/ML analytics, and data engineering concepts to develop and operationalize advanced hunting, anomaly detection, and behavioral analytics use cases.
* Proven experience with attack emulation and detection validation frameworks such as Atomic Red Team, Caldera, Prelude, AttackIQ, Sigma, YARA/YARA\-L, as well as fraud, identity, cloud, SaaS, OT, data leakage, and network anomaly detection use cases.

description:
**Role description** ***Who we are:***



At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. **Summary:**



UST is looking for 3D Modeler to create high\-fidelity, real\-time 3D assets used in immersive Virtual Reality (VR) training experiences. This role sits at the intersection of mechanical engineering and modern real\-time / game\-engine pipelines. The successful candidate will convert complex engineering inputs—such as CAD models, drawings, bills of material, and technical specifications—into accurate, optimized, and visually clear 3D assets suitable for interactive VR training environments.


This position works closely with VR developers, instructional designers, and engineering subject\-matter experts to ensure all assets are technically correct, performant on target hardware, and aligned with instructional intent





**The Opportunity:**



1\. Engineering\-to\-VR Asset Creation


* Translate complex mechanical drawings, CAD models, and specifications into accurate, VR\-ready 3D models and assemblies, using blender
* Maintain correct scale, tolerances, interfaces, and part relationships consistent with engineering intent.
* Interpret incomplete or ambiguous engineering data and collaborate with subject\-matter experts to resolve issues.
* Build assemblies and sub\-assemblies suitable for interactive training, including exploded views and service\-oriented breakdowns.

2\. Real\-Time Optimization for VR


* Create real\-time\-ready geometry using best practices for VR and game engines, including clean topology, efficient UV layouts, and appropriate polygon budgets.
* Generate and manage Levels of Detail (LODs) to ensure stable frame rates in VR environments.
* Bake high\-poly detail into low\-poly assets using normal maps and supporting texture maps.
* Optimize assets for draw calls, texture memory usage, and shader complexity based on VR performance constraints.

3\. Texturing, Materials, and Visual Clarity


* Create high\-quality Physically Based Rendering (PBR) materials using metal/roughness workflows.
* Produce textures, decals, and material variants that enhance realism while supporting training clarity.
* Develop visual variants such as simplified models, cutaways, highlights, and color\-coded components to support instructional goals.
* Ensure materials respond correctly across varied lighting conditions used in VR training scenarios.

4\. Workflow, Reviews, and Delivery


* Follow a consistent end\-to\-end modeling pipeline from CAD ingestion through mesh preparation, optimization, texturing, review, and final polish.
* Prepare assets with clean hierarchies, pivots, naming conventions, and documentation for seamless integration into VR applications.
* Participate in design and technical reviews, incorporating feedback from engineers, developers, and instructional designers.
* Maintain organized source files and documentation to support reuse, updates, and long\-term asset maintenance.

**What you need:**


* 3\+ years of professional experience creating real\-time 3D assets for VR, games, simulation, or interactive training.
* Strong proficiency with at least one major DCC tool such as Blender, Maya, or 3ds Max.
* Demonstrated experience with real\-time asset optimization, including LODs, baking, and texture optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with PBR texturing workflows and material creation.
* Mechanical engineering background (degree or equivalent practical experience) with the ability to interpret technical drawings and CAD data.
* Portfolio demonstrating hard\-surface and mechanical modeling with evidence of real\-time optimization.

**Required Skills:**


* Modeling / DCC Tools: Blender, Maya, 3ds Max (ZBrush optional for high\-detail sculpting)
* Texturing \& Materials: PBR workflows, Substance Painter or equivalent tools
* Optimization Techniques: LOD generation, texture atlases, normal map baking, polygon and draw\-call optimization
* Real\-Time Platforms: Unity and/or Unreal Engine (for asset validation and integration support)
* File Formats \& Delivery: Real\-time optimized formats such as FBX and glTF, with clean hierarchies and documentation

**Desired Skills:**


* Experience developing assets for industrial equipment, manufacturing tools, or technical training content.
* Familiarity with Unity or Unreal Engine for validating scale, lighting, and performance.
* Experience working with CAD\-to\-real\-time conversion pipelines.
* Understanding of VR\-specific usability considerations such as scale perception, visual comfort, and interaction clarity**.**

title: ASIC Verification Engineer (IP & SoC)
description:
Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled **ASIC Verification Engineer (IP \& SoC)** with 5 to 10 years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor verification. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining and executing verification strategies for complex IPs and SoCs, developing scalable UVM\-based verification environments, and validating high\-speed protocols such as AMBA AXI and PCIe. This role requires strong debugging expertise, automation skills, and experience working with industry\-standard EDA verification tools.
Responsibilities:
### **Verification Planning \& Execution**

* Define, develop, and execute comprehensive verification plans at both IP and SoC levels.
* Drive verification closure through functional coverage, code coverage, assertions, and regression analysis.
* Develop verification methodologies aligned with project requirements and quality standards.

### **Testbench Architecture \& Development**

* Architect and develop scalable, reusable constrained\-random verification environments using **SystemVerilog and UVM**.
* Create verification components, scoreboards, monitors, checkers, and reusable testbench infrastructure.
* Develop and execute directed, random, and stress test scenarios.

### **AMBA AXI Verification**

* Verify and validate **AXI3, AXI4, and AXI5** based subsystems.
* Validate AXI Interconnects, NoCs (Network\-on\-Chip), and multi\-layer bus architectures.
* Analyze and verify out\-of\-order transaction handling, latency optimization, and bandwidth performance.

### **PCIe Sub\-System Verification**

* Verify PCIe Gen3, Gen4, Gen5, and Gen6 controller functionality across Physical, Data Link, and Transaction Layers.
* Validate high\-performance DMA engines operating in Endpoint and Root Complex configurations.
* Ensure protocol compliance and robust performance under various traffic conditions.

### **Protocol \& Performance Verification**

* Verify high\-speed industry\-standard protocols and ensure compliance with protocol specifications.
* Execute performance verification to validate throughput, latency, and system\-level behavior.
* Support low\-power verification methodologies using UPF/CPF where applicable.

### **Debugging \& Failure Analysis**

* Debug complex simulation failures and identify root causes in RTL designs.
* Perform protocol\-level debugging and waveform analysis.
* Collaborate closely with design, architecture, and software teams to resolve issues efficiently.

### **Gate\-Level Simulation (GLS)**

* Set up and execute gate\-level simulations with and without timing annotations.
* Analyze timing\-related issues and support pre\-silicon signoff activities.

### **Automation \& Productivity Enhancement**

* Develop automation scripts using Python, Perl, or Tcl.
* Improve regression execution, result analysis, coverage tracking, and verification workflows.

Requirements:
### **Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Communication Engineering, VLSI, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

### **Experience**

* 5 to 10 years of proven experience in ASIC/SoC verification.
* Strong background in IP\-level and SoC\-level verification projects.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in **SystemVerilog and UVM**.
* Hands\-on experience with constrained\-random verification methodologies.
* Solid understanding of AMBA AXI protocols (AXI3/4/5\).
* Experience in verifying PCIe Gen3/4/5/6 subsystems.
* Knowledge of Network\-on\-Chip (NoC), interconnect architectures, and DMA engines.
* Experience with protocol compliance, functional coverage, assertions, and verification closure.

### **Low Power \& Performance Verification**

* Experience with low\-power verification using **UPF/CPF** (preferred).
* Understanding of performance verification techniques and system\-level analysis.

### **Automation Skills**

* Proficiency in scripting using **Python, Perl, or Tcl**.
* Experience automating verification and regression environments.

### **EDA Tools**


Hands\-on experience with one or more industry\-standard simulators:

* Synopsys VCS
* Cadence Xcelium
* Siemens Questa/QuestaSim

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with gate\-level simulations and timing analysis.
* Exposure to advanced verification methodologies and reusable verification IPs.
* Strong debugging, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced product development environment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineers
description:
Job Description
  
**Summary**

Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.


This is not a order\-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI\-enabled solutions.
* Build and deploy agentic AI systems end\-to\-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
* Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
* In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
* In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production\-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
* In Products: configure and deploy pre\-built agentic products into client environments.
* Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
* Apply AI\-native engineering practices — agent\-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
* Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
* Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
* Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
* Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early\-stage discovery.

**KEY MEASURES**

* Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
* Production\-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
* Demonstrable productivity through AI\-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
* Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
* Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release

  
Qualification
  
**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* 5\+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
* Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
* Full\-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
* Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
* Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
* Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
* Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer Lead
description:
Job Description
  
**SUMMARY**

The Forward Deployed Engineer Lead Practitioner sets the standard for how Avanade Next turns business ambition into production reality. A player\-coach responsible for the Forward Deployed Engineer track, this role combines business understanding, solution architecture and engineering leadership to help clients move from opportunity to deployed outcome. They work alongside executives, transformation leaders and domain specialists to understand strategic priorities, identify where AI can create measurable value, and translate those opportunities into production\-grade solutions.


Beyond delivery, this role defines the AI\-native engineering model for Avanade Next: small expert teams directing agent networks, accelerating delivery through reusable platforms and assets, and focusing engineering effort on solving business problems rather than writing code for its own sake. The role sets the technical standard, capability model and hiring bar for a track expected to scale from 20 engineers at launch to more than 100 practitioners over time.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Partner with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities, transformation initiatives and desired outcomes, and translate them into practical AI\-enabled solutions.
* Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solution concepts that are commercially viable, technically feasible and capable of operating at enterprise scale.
* Bridge the gap between strategy and execution by converting business cases, reinvention opportunities and transformation roadmaps into production\-ready solution architectures and delivery plans.
* Own the engineering standard for the FDE track, including solution architecture patterns, engineering practices, testing, evaluation, production readiness and operational support requirements.
* Define and continuously evolve AI\-native engineering practices, including agent\-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
* Define reference architectures, solution patterns and decision frameworks that help teams determine the most appropriate combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Avanade Agentic Platform and broader Microsoft capabilities for a given business problem.
* Set and maintain the hiring, assessment and capability\-development standards for the FDE track, ensuring practitioners can operate effectively across business, architecture and engineering domains.
* Lead the development of the FDE career pathway and enablement model, including structured re\-skilling of traditional delivery engineers into AI\-native Forward Deployed Engineers.
* Deploy personally onto the most complex, strategic, at\-risk or reference\-critical mandates, helping clients translate ambitious transformation objectives into successful production outcomes.
* Work closely with the AAP Platform Lead, IP \& Products Lead and Delivery \& Quality Lead to ensure solutions are built on repeatable foundations, contribute reusable assets back into the platform and meet Avanade Next production standards.
* Partner with Value Architects to ensure solutions are linked to measurable business outcomes and with Trust Architects to ensure governance, risk, evaluation and adoption requirements are designed into solutions from the outset.
* Contribute reusable solution patterns, reference architectures, engineering assets and delivery lessons from every major engagement to strengthen the Avanade Next platform, product portfolio and delivery model.

**KEY MEASURES**

* Engineering standard and reference stack published and applied across builds within the first quarter.
* Demonstrable productivity improvement across the FDE track through AI\-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
* Production\-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype accepted without a production path.
* Reusable components contributed per engagement, with measurable reuse across the track.
* Retention of FDE talent.

  
Qualification
  
**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* 8\+ years in software or AI engineering, with senior or lead accountability for systems that ran in production and were maintained afterwards.
* Deep, current, hands\-on agentic engineering: orchestration, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, observability and failure handling. Current practice matters more than years.
* Strong command of the Microsoft AI stack; equivalent depth on another stack considered where the transfer is credible.

* Experience assessing and hiring engineers at volume and at pace, with a defensible bar.
* Client\-facing credibility. This is a forward\-deployed track and its lead is deployed too, not directing from the studio.
* Comfortable building a capability where a large share of the bench arrives by internal transfer from traditional delivery and needs genuine re\-skilling.

title: XR Systems Technology Architect
description:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Systems Engineering
**General Summary:**

Qualcomm is a key enabler for the XR eco\-system with a dominant market share. We build custom SoCs and technologies that are at the heart of existing and emerging XR products. Qualcomm XR Systems organization is responsible for architecture definition of Qualcomm’s next generation XR SoCs. Our portfolio of SoC offerings serve a broad range of XR products covering Mixed Reality, Augmented Reality and AI Glass product families. The span of technologies that go into these products and SoCs include high resolution immersive displays, perception features that are bulit on computer vision and deep learning technology, highly efficient DSP processors, dedicated deep learning accelerators, graphics engines supporting high resolution and high frame rate rendering and reprojection, multimedia processing engines (audio, video, imaging,..), CPUs and SoC infrastructure that ensures efficient and secure processing, as well as very low power architecture features such as power islands and power rail isolation, sleep modes etc.


We are scaling up our operations!! We are looking for engineers with background in diverse areas including architecture and micro architecture definition, design and verification of IPs and SoCs. People who have experience in areas such as SoC architecture, networks on chip, virtual memory, on\-chip and off\-chip memory subsystems, security architecture, CPUs, etc, also development of IPs such as camera, video, GPU, DSPs, deep learning accelerators and neural signal processors (NSP), peripherals and interfaces such as PICe, SPI etc. Also, people with strong background on pre silicon and post silicon power estimation and optimization, performance estimation, power architecture design will be highly encouraged. We have openings at senior as well as junior job levels.


We are keenly interested in you if you are someone who has gained expertise in your specific domain which could be one or more of the areas mentioned above and are excited to take the next step in your career to become architects of the SoCs that will shape the future generations of XR products!! Apart from a rewarding career and growth prospects, the organization offers a unique opportunity to learn from a diverse set of experts working collaboratively under the same roof, towards a common goal.

Qualcomm's XR Systems team is seeking system architects who will work on defining the next generation SoC architectures, enabling the future of Augmented Reality / Virtual Reality / Mixed Reality applications. Responsibilities of successful candidates may span one or more of the following areas:

* Excellent problem solving and communication skills

* Experience with Mixed \& Augmented reality system design, constraints, and trade\-offs

* Proven experience in conducting architectural trade\-offs, power/performance analysis and/or SW\-HW trade\-offs
* Experience with system level modeling (performance and/or power)

**Keywords**

Camera, GPU, CPU, SOC, SoC architecture, NOC, DDR subsystem, LPDDR IP, caches, security, virtual memory, development, RTL design, Computer vision, Artificial Intelligence, ML, DSP, AR, VR, MR, XR

title: Senior ASIC Verification & Validation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.


Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.


Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

 **Job Description** **SoC Verification Engineer**


The **SoC Development team at Sandisk** is seeking highly motivated **SoC Verification Engineers** to join our talented team, working on cutting\-edge **controller development for high\-performance SoCs** used in industry\-leading products.

**Role \& Responsibilities:**


As a **SoC Verification Engineer**, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our SoC designs. You will be responsible for:

* Developing **verification test plans** based on design specifications.
* Creating and executing **test cases across multiple platforms**, including **RTL simulations, FPGA prototyping, and Palladium emulation**.
* Verification test structures (DFx Verification)
* Performing **Gate\-Level Simulations (GLS)** and debugging complex SoC designs.
* Collaborating with design, architecture, and firmware teams to define verification strategies and drive **coverage\-driven verification methodologies**.
* Contributing to the development of advanced **verification environments**, including UVM, PSS testbenches.
* Analyzing **functional coverage and simulation results** to enhance verification efficiency and effectiveness.
* Generating Functional patterns required for Wafer Sorting.**Why Join Us?**


At **Sandisk**, you’ll be part of a team of highly skilled engineers solving complex verification challenges and driving innovations in **data storage solutions**. Your work will directly impact the performance and reliability of high\-volume new age data solutions, consumer and enterprise products.


Together, we’ll push the boundaries of technology, unlock the full potential of data, and shape the future of storage solutions

 **Qualifications** **Required**:

* BE or MS degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or Computer Engineering, with 4\-8 years of experience
* Deep understanding of C, System Verilog UVM and coverage driven verification methodology
* Working experience in Verifying Processor based SoC's (ARM, RISC\-V, ARC)
* Experience in DFX Verification
* Experience to generate functional patterns used for Post\-Silicon testing.
* History of building and improving UVM based verification methodology

**Skills**:

* Develop and execute verification plans
* Proficiency with C, Verilog, System Verilog and UVM based verification
* Knowledge in various interfaces – **PCIe or DDR,** UART, I2C, I2S, SPI

Experience working on processor\-based SoC * \- ARC/ARM/RISC..
* Experience in implementing advanced test benches, verification models, scoreboards/checkers.
* Knowledge in bus protocols \- **AXI, AHB, APB** and bus interconnects
* Experience with test plan creation and test\-bench development
* Experience with test development and test coverage assessment
* Excellent debugging and problem\-solving skill
* Create and modify SoC\-level, and sub\-system level test benches.
* Experience in setting up and running gate\-level simulations
* Gate Level / Power\-Aware simulations
* Great written and verbal communication skills
* Good Programming/Scripting skills with languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, and BASH
* Interest in ASICs, SoCs, flash memory, semiconductor components
* Strong team player who can collaborate with colleagues

  

**Additional Information**  

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. description:

Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Validation Engineer with expertise in pharmaceutical Serialization and Track \& Trace solutions, preferably the TraceLink platform, and at least 5 years of Computer System Validation (CSV) experience in the pharmaceutical or life\-sciences industry. The role requires practical knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP computerized\-system validation, and data integrity. The successful candidate should understand serialization processes, partner onboarding, system integrations, serial number management, EPCIS data exchange, regulatory reporting, and global Track \& Trace requirements. Key Responsibilities · Plan, author, review, and execute CSV activities for GxP\-regulated serialization and Track \& Trace systems. · Perform validation activities for TraceLink or equivalent serialization applications, interfaces, and related integrations. · Develop, review, and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including the following: · Validation Plans · User Requirements Specifications (URS) · Functional and Design Specifications · GxP and system risk assessments · Installation Qualification, Operational Qualification, and Performance Qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) protocols · Test scripts and objective test evidence. · Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM) · Validation Summary Reports · Execute functional, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end validation testing for serialization systems and interfaces. · Validate serialization processes including serial number management, commissioning, aggregation, EPCIS data exchange, partner onboarding, regulatory reporting, and exception handling. · Apply risk\-based validation and maintain traceability among requirements, risks, test cases, defects, and validation evidence. · Document and investigate validation deviations, test failures, defects, and discrepancies, and support their timely resolution. · Support system changes, upgrades, patches, enhancements, and integrations through established change\-control and validation processes. · Maintain validation documentation in an inspection\-ready state and support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory inspections. · Ensure compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP, data\-integrity requirements, and electronic\-record/electronic\-signature controls. Serialization and TraceLink Competencies · Platform experience: Hands\-on experience with pharmaceutical serialization solutions; TraceLink experience is strongly preferred. · Partner onboarding: Experience supporting onboarding and end\-to\-end testing across serialization networks and external partners. · Integration landscape: Experience validating data exchange between enterprise serialization platforms, packaging sites, 3PLs, CMOs or contract manufacturers, Marketing Authorization Holders (MAHs), and other supply\-chain partners. · Serial number management: Knowledge of serial number provisioning to packaging lines, pools and ranges, and CMO/MAH\-related processes. · Serialization events: Understanding of commissioning, decommissioning, aggregation, disaggregation, packing, unpacking, shipping, receiving, and related events. · EPCIS and troubleshooting: Ability to investigate interface failures, transaction errors, EPCIS issues, and data discrepancies. · Global requirements: Working knowledge of pharmaceutical serialization requirements across markets such as the United States, European Union, China, and Canada. Preferred Serialization Experience · Experience with Serialization / Track \& Trace systems. · Hands\-on TraceLink configuration, validation, partner onboarding, or end\-to\-end integration testing. · Experience with SAP ICH/ASN processes, EPCIS transactions, and message analysis. · Knowledge of GS1 serialization standards and packaging\-line integration. · Experience with global serialization regulatory reporting. · Experience supporting serialization or Track \& Trace implementations, upgrades, migrations, or enhancements. Tools, Processes, and Collaboration · Experience using ServiceNow for RITMs or service requests, incident management, and change requests or change control. · Experience supporting deviations, Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs), change controls, and production issues in a regulated environment. · Ability to collaborate effectively with Quality, IT, Packaging, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Automation, and external partners.

TraceLink, SAP, EPCIS, ServiceNow

description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in software development and 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
* 8 years of experience building and developing large\-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture.
* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Proven ability to lead complex, cross\-functional technical projects from conception to completion and drive technical strategy in a multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Familiarity with performance analysis, modeling, and tuning of complex systems, particularly in the areas of resource management.
* Deeply technical Engineering Manager (EM) with a proven track record of stabilizing and growing high\-impact teams.

**About the job**
-----------------


Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started \- and as a manager, you guide the way.  

  

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large\-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the design and implementation of a holistic, self\-healing resource distribution ecosystem. Turn a big\-picture goal into concrete projects for yourself and the team.
* Operationalize the potential of Agentic Fleet Management. Lead the transition to artifact\-motivated software development, ensuring that user intent is captured as structured artifacts to guide autonomous agents.
* Manage high\-impact challenges at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems, risk modeling, and policy enforcement. Design universal, high\-level resource abstractions that operate above the level of a single data center.
* Collaborate with partner teams across the Core Cloud Artificial Intelligence (C2ai) organization, ML Fleet, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and all Product Areas to define requirements and deliver a unified platform.
* Coach and grow engineers on the team, build a strong leadership bench, while fostering a culture of technical excellence, strategic thinking, and innovation.
